title: Burnout Prevention
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Do you suffer from chronic fatigue or insomnia. Do you find yourself catching colds more often or perhaps not finding joy in everyday things that used to be fun?  Join our FREE workshop and discover the early symptoms of burnout and practical tips on prevention and increasing your energy.
description:
About your Hosts:

Katarina Gaborova, MSc, founder of K.G Psychological Services

Katarina works as a  registered NIP psychologist in the Netherlands and a Gottman certified therapist for couples.  Katarina uses an eclectic approach to therapy by combining  CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy), Voice dialogue, EMDR (Eye movement  desensitization and reprocessing), NLP (Neurolinguistic programming),  BWRT (Brain working Recursive Therapy) and other approaches in her work with clients. She regularly delivers mental health training workshops. Learn more about Katarina at her website.

Sandra Delgado Quist, Homeopath & Founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre

Sandra incorporates her experience as a professional homeopath and Reiki teacher in her practice of energy medicine to help clients regain their health using natural therapies. She hosts regular workshops teaching people how to use homeopathy and natural remedies for common ailments. As Founder of the centre, she also facilitates in-company workshops on various topics to bring awareness to natural medicine and the various therapies available for common diseases. Learn more about Sandra at her website.

Kim Brice, Mindfulness Stress Reduction Coach

Kim is a burnout prevention and recovery coach specializing in mindfulness-based stress reduction approaches. She has been a member of the Centrum voor Mindfulness training faculty, one of The Netherlands’ most pre-eminent centers promoting mindfulness. Mindfulness is a training for the brain that allows you to relate to and  manage the adverse physical, mental and emotional effects of stress more skillfully. She regularly facilitates in-company workshops on burnout prevention and workplace mental health in companies through The Self Investigation, a foundation she co-founded in 2020. Learn more about Kim’s personal practice at her website.

title: Parenting the ADHD child
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Has your beautiful child been diagnosed with ADHD? As a parent, do you have enough information about how to best support your child in order to help them thrive? What exactly are these labels? Are you aware that natural remedies that can support your child's emotions?
description:
In this talk, Jacinta Noonan, a trained Psychologist specialising in ADHD will help you  understand how the ADHD brain operates and share insightful  information on why your child does what he/she does. You will learn why  parenting techniques that work for your other children  don’t work for your child with ADHD and what you can do instead. You will leave the session feeling much  better equipped to tweak your parenting skills for  the ADHD brain-wiring.

The session will also include a talk from Kairavi Vora, a homeopathic physician who will offer tips about using natural remedies to assist with the emotional symptoms expressed by your child. She will also include some additional information food and physical activities to help balance the overall health of your child. Kairavi works at the centre helping people with many conditions including anxiety, depression or other emotional imbalances.

Lastly, we'll hear from Adina Ciocoiu, Gestalt Counsellor (in training). She will guide a relational awareness exercise to explore the contact between parent and child. Through her training and lived experience, Adina supports individuals that struggle with personal/work relationships (such as burnout, anxiety, depression), navigating an expat/immigrant life or understanding the emotional aspects of chronic pain and traumatic injuries of the body.

We hope you will join us for this informative workshop.

title: Mommy & Me
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Are you a first time mother or balancing several young children? Do you want to strengthen your child's immune system naturally? Are you exhausted because your child does not sleep? Then this workshop is made just for you!  Empower yourself to take care of your family naturally.
description:
This workshop is meant to empower mothers with the tools to care for their family naturally.  Mothers have all experienced late nights of feeling helpless and exhausted when your child is experiencing teething pains, sudden fevers, growing pains or simply inconsistent sleep patterns. Arm yourself with a few tools to make motherhood more enjoyable for the entire family.

About your speakers:

Sandra Delgado Quist is a Homeopath, Reiki Teacher and the Founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre. Her journey to become a natural health pracitioner started while living abroad and becoming a mother.  Being so far away from her own mother and sisters,  she didn't want to feel helpless as a mother. So she found herself exploring complementary medicine for first aid situations and this ignited her passion for natural medicine.

In this workshop, Sandra will provide a basic understanding of using homeopathic remedies for common ailments such as coughs, colds, colic, teething, growing pains, minor injuries and much more! She will also offer tips on using Schuessler Tissue Salts and Flower Essences that are essential for growth and development in both mother and child.

Vanessa  is the founder of Like Dreaming Baby & Toddler Sleep Coaching  practice, a Certified Gentle Sleep Coach® and Mom of three young boys.  Once a sleep-deprived, first-time mother, Vanessa knows like no other  how devastating it can be when your child does not sleep well. She has  made it her mission to help as many sleepless families as  possible, using gentle, loving and responsive methods.

In  the Mommy and Me workshop, she will walk you through the 6 main reasons  children do not sleep well. Find out how you can overcome early  rising, frequent night wakings, poor napping and dependencies on  rocking, nursing, etc. The focus for this workshop is on sleeping for babies and children who are older  than 5 months.

***PLEASE NOTE: In order to offer enough 1-1 time for questions from attendees, space is limited***

title: Ageism
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: What is Ageism, how does it impact us and how can we overcome it?  Join us for an insightful discussion on how stereotypes limit us as individuals and society at large. All ages welcome.
description:
Join us for an insightful discussion on how stereotypes limit us as individuals and society at large. The Ageism topic will feature 3 speakers addressing the same topic from their respective areas of expertise. These 'living room chats' offer a safe space allowing people to ask questions and engage with others who might be experiencing similar circumstances. Our guest speakers this month include:

Mary Jane Roy, a Stress & Resilience Expert and Advocate for thriving, INclusive  & INtergenerational workspaces. She will begin by addressing what Ageism is, how it affects both young and old and why it is an important topic. Mary Jane has discussed Ageism within various corporations in order to bring awareness to these unrecognised biasis that affect so many people. Find out more about Mary Jane at CreatingWaves

Sandra Delgado Quist, is a homeopathic practitioner and the Founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre. She will offer tips for natural remedies that assist people experiencing the consequences of ageism such as low confidence, perfectionism, procrastination and more. Additionally, Sandra will discuss how to overcome some of the physical symptoms people experience in the workplace such as exhaustion, brain fog, and mental fatigue. Find out more about Sandra at her website: SDQ Homeopathy

Berit Lewis, is the CEO of Thriving Life, which offers talks, courses and workshops in healthy mental living. She holds a BA (Honours) in Psychology, a MSc in Vitality and Ageing and a MA in Communication. Berit is the author of the book Ageing Upwards, in which she invites the readers to embrace their age and take responsibility for their own health, well-being and ageing process by practicing mindfulness. She will talk about how mindfulness can help us embrace our age, based on research she has done in collaboration with Leiden Academy for Vitality and Ageing. She will end the evening with a brief mindfulness meditation. Find out more about Berit at her website:  ThrivingLife

We look forward to welcoming you at The Hague Natural Health Centre for this

location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Do you find it difficult to fall and stay asleep? Perhaps you've adapted to getting minimal sleep and it has become normal. A lack of sleep is bound to affect your life in ways you may not expect. Join our workshop to learn about potential causes of insomnia and how to overcome it.
description:
Join us for an insightful discussion about sleep patterns and how to determine if you suffer from insomnia or simply need to make a few lifestyle changes to get your sleep back on track. The workshop will feature 2 speakers addressing the same topic from their respective areas of expertise.

These 'living room chats' offer a safe space allowing people to ask questions and engage with others who might be experiencing similar circumstances. The audiences are usually small which allow for more engaging conversations.

Our guest speakers this month include:

Carolyn Tabak is a Psychologist with over 30 years of therapeutic practice and a supervisor for counsellors and other therapists. She incorporates EMDR, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) and other techniques when working with her clients. In this workshop, Carolyn will outline the symptoms of chronic insomnia versus sleep disruptions due to existing life circumstances. She will offer tips that will help you drift into slumber and stay asleep so that you can wake up feeling refreshed. Find out more about Carolyn at her website:  Psychologies-Unlimited

Sandra Delgado Quist, is a Homeopath, Reiki Practitioner and the Founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre. Sandra will discuss how homeopathy can help identify some of the things that might be keeping us awake and how homeopathy can assist with insomnia. She will offer guidance in using natural remedies for sleep as well as tips to find out if you are lacking in minerals that might be hindering your rest.  Find out more about Sandra at her website: SDQ Homeopathy

We look forward to welcoming you at The Hague Natural Health Centre for this interactive discussion.

title: Embracing Mortality
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: How often do we truly think about mortality? Join us for a profound introspection into the essence of existence, a journey often shunned in everyday discourse yet inevitably woven into our experiences.
description:
Join us for an honest discussion about end of life, this event is for anyone and everyone.

We prepare and celebrate the birth of a new child but often neglect to prepare and honor the transition to death. In some societies it is even taboo to even speak about the topic, But what would we change if we integrated our mortality as a way of living?

In this series of 'the living room chats', we discuss the gift of our mortality and the considerations we should be aware of in the transition phase. We will also offer natural options for pain management in terminal cases that provide people with a better quality of life. Lastly, we will discuss the role of the Healer in the Transition Phase and  suggest an approach to working with Groups to ease and support this  process.

The topic will be discussed from 3 different aspects by the following guest speakers:

Liza Berenfeld, Death Douhla is a death doula living and working in Den Haag. In times when we are dying more at medical facilities where body care is a priority, the death doula (or soul midwife) provides soul care to the people at the end of life, their loved ones and communities. Liza also supports people in grief and helps explore mortality and the fear of death. Liza worked previously as a commercial legal counsel for 17 years and after the beautiful experience of her mother's death, she trained as a death doula including hospice volunteering as part of her education. She established her own practice in May 2024. You can find more about LIza on ther Instagram @death_doula_den_haag.

Kairavi Vora is a Homeopathic Doctor from India, with many years of experience in clinical homeopathic practice. She treats patients with  a vast range of acute  and chronic symptoms, including respiratory complaints, digestive  ailments, female disorders and allergic complaints. In this talk, Kairavi will highlight natural remedies that can be used for pain management to enable people to have a better quality of life as they transition. She  believes that every individual deserves good health and aims to  contribute to this cause with her expert knowledge and experience. You can read more about Kairavi at her website: Heal with Homeopathy

Rebecca Winter works as a Coach & Talent Leader in the corporate  world. She also runs a private Coachinng & Wellness practice  alongside. In the Business World, she has a background in Leadership,  Change & Transformation, and HR. As a Wellness Professional, she is  trained as an NLP Master Practitioner, Multiple Brain Integration (mBIT)  Master Coach and Trainer, Systematic Kinesiologist, Bengston Energy  Healer, Body Code Practitioner, ICF Certified Coach, and IIN Health  Coach. It is Rebecca’s mission to partner with every individual to  access their own, innate wisdom - that which emanates from within - to  seek solutions to their challenges, freedom from pain and discomfort,  and to step into their own Sovereignty. You can read more about Rebecca at her website: Emanant.eu

title: Let's talk about Anxiety
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: People of all ages are experiencing anxiety. Whether it is related to work, school, relationships or just simply feeling insecure. How do you manage your day when your are feeling so lost? Join us for a discussion about different ways of managing anxiety so you get through your day with confidence.
description:
Join us for a discussion about anxiety, what it is and tools for managing it.

Anxiety is a response from our nervous system, usually to unspecific fears or certain triggers. Short periods of anxiety are normal and part of life. For example during an exam period or an unusual stress period. However, persistent anxiety can truly limit us and compromise our quality of life. It can keep us from doing the things we enjoy and ultimately be detrimental to our health due to the pro-longed high levels of cortisol.

In this series of 'the living room chats', we discuss the idea of anxiety and how it manifests in various ways depending mostly on life experiences. The topic will be discussed from 3 different aspects by the following guest speakers:

Rawia Liverpool, Multicultural Transactional Analysis Counsellor & NLP Master Practitioner. She offers individual consultations at her practice Recipes4Change on issues relating to big life transitions, anxiety and overwhelm, communication and self-confidence. Being female and mixed race, she understands and provides support on issues relating to discrimination, identity and belonging. In this presentation, Rawia will bring to our awareness how our personal history, personality and relational patterns may be contributing to our anxiety. You can find our more about Rawia on her website: Recipes4Change

Sandra Quist is the Founder and Director of The Hague Natural Health Centre and a practicing homeopath. In her practice, she regularly works with clients who sometimes do not realise they are suffering from anxiety and have merely booked an appointment because the anxiety is manifesting in the form of physical complaints. In this discussion, she will discuss the use of natural remedies such as Flower Essences, Tissue Salts and of course homeopathic remedies that can be used for acute anxiety but also chronic anxiety. You can read more about Sandra at her website: SandraDelgadoQuist

Annette Nilsson works as a Life Coach adding horse therapy to her sessions. Annette is passionate about helping people in their personal development. She will discuss why horses are perfect partners  in helping people with anxiety. Horses can help regulate the nervous  system and through a non-judgmental connection, we can learn to regulate  our response to anxiety, and find more peace within ourselves. Next to  explaining about the nervous system and co-regulation through horses,  Annette will share some simple tools which can help aleviate anxiety. Learn more about Annette at her website: Alive-lifecoaching.com

title: Gut Health: How do you know if your gut is healthy?
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: We rarely give our gut the attention it deserves, yet it plays a crucial role in our overall health. Symptoms like bloating, gas, and constipation are just a few indicators of an imbalanced gut. Join us to discover how to recognize these signs and get practical tips for restoring your gut health.
description:
A healthy gut means more  than simply avoiding annoyances like bloating or heartburn. It’s  central to your health and connected to everything in your body. In this series of the 'living room chats' we will discuss how to recognise gut imbalances and offer various tips on managing and improving your gut health. Our expert guests this month include:

Shay Klomp Bueters, Functional Medicine Consultant at Contagiously Healthy. Functional Medicine has been a game changer for Shay after experiencing firsthand the power of nutrition and burnout. She now aims to empower others to reclaim their health. In this workshop, Shay will discuss the number one root cause of the common gut issues including parasites, dysbiosis, auto-immune challenges and offer steps to restore balance through functional medicine. Find out more about Shay at her website Contagiously-healthy.com.

Rosy Van Den Berg Intriago Murillo, Founder of the RI Institute of Bio Health Services. Rosy has spent years researching nutrition and the affects on the body and chronic illness. She is the founder of the RI Instutute and Consultancy which offers biological products and encourages muscle movement for maintaining a healthy lifestyle. In this talk, Rosy will discuss detoxing the body using bio nutrition and sport and the importance of the emotional detox. Find out more about Rosy at her website RI Institute.

Archana Munot, Ayurvedic Consultant, Maharishi Ayurveda. Archana worked as an Ayurvedic doctor for several years in the busy hospitals of Pune India and now teaches Ayurveda to medical doctors in The Netherlands.  She has experience in treating a range of disorders including psoriasis, allergies, digestion, reproductive diseases, PCOS, menorrhagia and more. At this event, Archana will highlight the ancient practices of Ayurveda, describe the main body types according to Ayurveda and provide tips to aid in digestion, bloating, constipation and more. Find out more about Archana at Maharishi Ayurveda.

We look forward to seeing you at The Hague Natural Health Centre for another enriching discussion.

title: Health Perfectionism
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Do you find yourself wondering: Am I eating the right things? Am I living the right life? Why do I feel unhappy when my life seems to be so perfect on the outside? Join us for an exploration about our strive for perfection in life.
description:
Join us for an insightful discussion about society's obsession with perfection in the way we nourish our physical and emotional bodies creating a sense of anxiety about our health. The workshop will feature 3 speakers addressing the same topic from their respective areas of expertise.

These 'living room chats' offer a safe space allowing people to ask questions and engage with others who might be experiencing similar circumstances. The audiences are usually small which allow for more engaging conversations.

Our guest speakers this month include:

Carolyn Tabak is a Psychologist with over 30 years of therapeutic practice and a supervisor for counsellors and other therapists. She incorporates EMDR, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) and other techniques when working with her clients. In this workshop, Carolyn will discuss the health-conscious individual that likes to research and take charge of their health. The type of person that follows a number of health and wellness influencers and then tries to implement their advice but alas they still feel they are not doing enough or not reaching their ideal health goals. Find out more about Carolyn at her website:  Psychologies-Unlimited

Chungmei Cheng is an HSP Coach and Somatic Therapist at  Orchid of Life. In her work, Chungmei guides highly  sensitive people to process their trauma's; transforming sadness, anger,  fear, guilt, shame, disappointment so they are able to feel and act  upon their inner power, natural self-esteem and intuition. She uses a  variety of coaching tools to support personal growth on a mental,  emotional, physical and spiritual level. In this discussion, Chungmei will approach the topic by looking at those driven and successful people are constantly trying different things to feel better but their drive for perfection often leads to Burnout. Often people want a quick fix but what they really need is time and space to integrate their own healing process. Find out more about Chungmei at her website:  Orchidoflife.nl

Audrey Dickinson  is a qualified Nutritionist with a diploma in Nutritional Science &  Therapeutics and Health Coaching from the Irish Institute of Nutrition  and Health (IINH). She is also a registered member of the Nutritional Therapists of Ireland (NTOI).  Audrey will discuss the aspect of perfectionism from the nutritional side when individuals set unrealistic standards for their eating habits, leading to stress and guilt. This mindset can manifest as an obsession with "eating clean" or maintaining a flawless diet, which can be overwhelming. The constant pressure to make the "right" food choices may result in anxiety, as people worry about eating something deemed unhealthy or not meeting their ideal nutritional goals. Over time, this can create a rigid relationship with food, impacting not only mental well-being but also overall health and enjoyment of eating. Find out more about Audrey at her website:  Nourish&Flourish

We look forward to seeing you at The Hague Natural Health Centre for our next living room chat.

title: Grief Support Circle - monthly event
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
price_text: Grief Circle | More info | Pay what you want | +Ticket service fee | Sale ended
registration_text: See other events
summary: Grief is a part of life, we all experience it at some point but sometimes we get stuck in the emotion. Join us for an open discussion about our relationship with grief, how it impacts our life and simply be among people experiencing similar circumstances.
description:
After the success of our Embracing Mortality event in July, we recognised that there is a need for people to have a space to freely discuss their experiences with grief. The evening will be facilitated Liza Berenfeld,  a Death Doula and will also be joined by an occasional therapist from the health centre to offer support as needed.

Please note, this is not meant to replace personal therapy, it is a place for people within the community to gather, share and perhaps learn from each other.

About the evening:

We all love someone or something, which means we will be losing or have already gone through the loss.  Loss can be gradual and expected, or sudden and shocking. There is always a before and after the loss. Loss of any kind invites us to go deep into the garden of our soul and to meet the grief. The outer world at the same time keeps living at a usual quick pace, making no apologies for the griever.

Grief is the natural response to loss. We all grieve differently depending on biological, psychological, and social needs. Externally we can witness and express grief in mourning which is impacted by cultural, religious, traditional, and personal factors. But we all need a safe place, acceptance in grief, and care in transitional moments like learning to leave with grief.

Don’t stay alone!

We invite you to join us at our monthly healing circles “Holding our Grief Together” especially for people:

- who feel the need to be heard and seen in grief

- seeking support to move through grief together with others

- willing to share their story and support others as part of the healing process

What to expect?

Safe and tender environment to express your grief in the circle of other persons with relatable experiences of loss.

We will support you with:

- Discussing the physiology and spirituality of grief
- Participate in Grief moving exercises
- Sharing stories

Who are we not?

Please kindly note! Those meetings are facilitated by a death doula, who provides non-medical spiritual guidance. The doula is not a psychologist or psychiatric doctor, so we are unable to provide support to people with mental disorders.

Practical:

We have chosen different grief line groups to attend on Friday evenings once a month

October 18 - Grief & Loss Discussion

November 15 - Loss of our parents & Dementia parents

December 13 - Loss of Health

January 17 - Loss of Identity

February 14 - Loss of Love

Like the centre itself, the circle is evolving and experimenting to meet the needs of the community. We welcome people of all ages and backgrounds.

title: Meditation in Motion
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary:
Meditation is a jump beyond life. It is not getting out of life. It is getting to the very center of Life - Osho
Join us for a series of six sessions designed to guide you through a dynamic and collective exploration of diverse meditation techniques.
description:
Who Is This For?

This series is open to anyone curious about deepening their self-awareness, exploring new ways of being, and seeking a deeper connection with their emotions and sense of aliveness. No prior meditation experience is required—just a willingness to be curious, explore, play, and grow.

What to Expect

- A safe, respectful, and confidential environment
- Practices involving body movement, silence, voice work, music, dance, and sharing
- An opportunity to express yourself with whatever arises in the moment
- A journey that include depth, curiosity, and fun!
- Clear, heartfelt guidance and support throughout

The Purpose Inspired on ancient Buddhist, Sufi, and Tibetan methods, these active and passive techniques are designed to reconnect you with your sensations and feelings. They encourage you to stay present and grounded in your body, cultivating greater awareness of yourself and your surroundings. Through this reconnection with the Self, you can access deeper states of relaxation, clarity, and stillness, elevating the sense of presence and awareness in your daily life.

These practices offer a healthy approach to managing stress, tension, anxiety, and challenging situations. By incorporating body movement, they help release physical, mental, emotional, and energetic blockages too. Furthermore, they nourish and improve self-esteem, creativity, mental clarity, and connection to your heart and inner being.

This is a safe and supportive space to move from mind to no-mind, passing through your heart to the essence of your being. See the description below for specific details about each meditation.

About your Facilitator

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_7e0a7fa8156f4acb96fcd8cf29a6e312~mv2.jpeg)

Pratiti Meunier, is a Somatic Experiencing® Trauma Healing Practitioner, Holistic Counselor, Bodyworker & Reiki Practitioner, Meditation Teacher, and Life Explorer, with over two decades of experience in personal development, workshops, training, individual sessions and working with people in multicultural and international fields. Meditations are facilitated in English

The six week transformative journey through meditation includes the following themes:

31 October - Kundalini Meditation

“Be loose and let your whole body shake, let go and become the shaking. Dance…. In any way you feel, and let the whole body moves as it wishes. Close your eyes, witnessing whatever is happening inside and out. Be still….”

7  November - Chakra Breathing Meditation

Supported by a deep and fast breathing and body movement, we will journey through our chakras to experience and feel each one of them. Coming along with sounds and music, this meditation helps us to connect, open and bring awareness and vitality to our energy centers.

14 November - Fire Meditation

Through movements, expression, intensity, silence, we allow ourselves to feel the layers of our personality, recognizing our patterns, blockages and inviting with curiosity which energy is hidden under/behind this. An invitation to embrace our Light, our Longing, our Life.

21 November - Devavani Meditation

“The Divine Voice that moves and talks through you…”You will experience a technique that brings relaxation to the conscious part of the mind, so deeply that you can experience an unexpected silence.

28 November - Heart Chakra Meditation

Based in a Sufi tradition, this meditation is a simple and soft technique to reconnect us with our Heart, to release inner tension and allow the energy of the Heart Chakra, love to ourselves and others, flows again.

5 December - Prayer Meditation

Despite any religion, when we merge with energy we enter in Prayer. It changes you and when you change, the whole Existence changes.

It's the idea that you begin a new habit of going within through meditation over the 6 weeks, but you can also join a few sessions to test the waters. We hope to see you there!

title: Meltdowns & Temper Tantrums - ONLINE EVENT
location: Zoom link provided at registration
registration_text: See other events
summary: When faced with our children's challenging behaviors, it's crucial to examine how our own upbringing and emotional well-being influence our reactions. By understanding our personal triggers and regulation patterns, we can better support our children during their emotional challenges.
description:
Have you ever been in a situation where your child simply needs more of your time in that moment than you are able to give? This scenario is experienced time and again as a meltdown or temper tantrum in throughout various stages in a child's development. Often times, we as parents need to become aware of how our own upbringing and emotional wellbeing impact our child. Join us for our next 'living room chat' when 3 different therapists will be offering their expertise on managing through your child's emotional outbreaks.

NOTE: In order to accommodate parents who wish to attend but are unable to get away too long, this event is being hosted online - in YOUR living room 😃

Your speakers include:

Archana Munot, Ayurvedic Consultant, Maharishi Ayurveda. Archana worked as an Ayurvedic doctor for several years in the busy hospitals of Pune India and now teaches Ayurveda to medical doctors in The Netherlands.  She has experience in treating a range of disorders including psoriasis, allergies, digestion, reproductive diseases, PCOS, menorrhagia and more. At this event, Archana will highlight the ancient practices of child rearing according to Ayurveda. She will offer tips in supporting your child through the various developmental stages so that they grow up feeling more secure and with a solid foundation. Find out more about Archana at Maharishi Ayurveda.

Vanessa De Malmazet, Founder of Like Dreaming Baby & Toddler Sleep Coaching.  Vanessa is a Certified Gentle Sleep Coach® and Mom of three young boys.  Once a sleep-deprived, first-time mother, Vanessa knows like no other  how devastating it can be when your child does not sleep well. She has  made it her mission to help as many sleepless families as  possible, using gentle, loving and responsive methods. In this discussion, she will walk you through the 6 main reasons  children do not sleep well. Find out how you can overcome early  rising, frequent night wakings, poor napping and dependencies on  rocking, nursing, etc. The focus for this workshop is on sleeping for babies and children who are older  than 5 months. Find out more about Vanessa at LikeDreaming.nl

Claudia Carter, Special Educator, Instructor & Family Counsellor. Claudia leverages her experience as a Special Educator and Positive Education Instructor, to create personalized programs focused on emotional, social, and cognitive development for families with neurodivergent children. Her approach involves close collaboration with families and utilizes interactive methods to foster nurturing environments that support children's growth. In this discussion, Claudia will focus on the parents and how their own up bringing and emotional well being can impact their child's behavioral patterns and offer an exercise to assist in this process. Find out more about Claudia at Lucida-Workshops

We look forward to seeing you at The Hague Natural Health Centre for another enriching discussion.

description:
Who Is This For?

This series is open to anyone curious about deepening their self-awareness, exploring new ways of being, and seeking a deeper connection with their emotions and sense of aliveness. No prior meditation experience is required—just a willingness to be curious, explore, play, and grow.

What to Expect

- A safe, respectful, and confidential environment
- Practices involving body movement, silence, voice work, music, dance, and sharing
- An opportunity to express yourself with whatever arises in the moment
- A journey that include depth, curiosity, and fun!
- Clear, heartfelt guidance and support throughout

The Purpose Inspired on ancient Buddhist, Sufi, and Tibetan methods, these active and passive techniques are designed to reconnect you with your sensations and feelings. They encourage you to stay present and grounded in your body, cultivating greater awareness of yourself and your surroundings. Through this reconnection with the Self, you can access deeper states of relaxation, clarity, and stillness, elevating the sense of presence and awareness in your daily life.

These practices offer a healthy approach to managing stress, tension, anxiety, and challenging situations. By incorporating body movement, they help release physical, mental, emotional, and energetic blockages too. Furthermore, they nourish and improve self-esteem, creativity, mental clarity, and connection to your heart and inner being.

This is a safe and supportive space to move from mind to no-mind, passing through your heart to the essence of your being. See the description below for specific details about each meditation.

About your Facilitator

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_7e0a7fa8156f4acb96fcd8cf29a6e312~mv2.jpeg)

Pratiti Meunier, is a Somatic Experiencing® Trauma Healing Practitioner, Holistic Counselor, Bodyworker & Reiki Practitioner, Meditation Teacher, and Life Explorer, with over two decades of experience in personal development, workshops, training, individual sessions and working with people in multicultural and international fields. The six week transformative journey through meditation includes the following themes:

31 October - Kundalini Meditation

“Be loose and let your whole body shake, let go and become the shaking. Dance…. In any way you feel, and let the whole body moves as it wishes. Close your eyes, witnessing whatever is happening inside and out. Be still….”

7  November - Chakra Breathing Meditation

Supported by a deep and fast breathing and body movement, we will journey through our chakras to experience and feel each one of them. Coming along with sounds and music, this meditation helps us to connect, open and bring awareness and vitality to our energy centers.

14 November - Fire Meditation

21 November - Devavani Meditation

“The Divine Voice that moves and talks through you…”You will experience a technique that brings relaxation to the conscious part of the mind, so deeply that you can experience an unexpected silence.

28 November - Heart Chakra Meditation

Based in a Sufi tradition, this meditation is a simple and soft technique to reconnect us with our Heart, to release inner tension and allow the energy of the Heart Chakra, love to ourselves and others, flows again.

5 December - Prayer Meditation

Despite any religion, when we merge with energy we enter in Prayer. It changes you and when you change, the whole Existence changes.

It's the idea that you begin a new habit of going within through meditation over the 6 weeks, but you can also join a few sessions to test the waters. We hope to see you there!

title: 'Tis the Season?
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary:
IS it the season to be jolly? This time of year is stressful for many people. End of year filings, holiday gatherings, school commitments, grief for missing loved ones. 

Join us for tips on finding strength & resilience this time of year.
description:
Is this the season to be jolly? According to the media, everyone is happy, jolly, and having fun. But in reality, this time of year can bring added stress. Whether it’s meeting year-end deadlines, missing loved ones, traveling to family, or hopping from celebration to celebration, life can feel hectic and overwhelming!

Join us for our next living room chat to explore the stress that many face during the holiday season. Our experts will offer valuable tips and exercises to help you navigate this time of year with strength, resilience, and peace of mind.

Your speakers include:

Mary Jane Roy, Founder of Creating Waves. A Stress, Resilience & Emotional Agility Expert, Mary Jane will start by explaining how stress affects us physiologically and emotionally. She’ll introduce the 8 Variables of Resilience, giving you practical steps to become more resilient and stress ‘hardy’. Learn more about Mary Jane at Creating Waves.

Jenny Mason, Transformation Coach & Trainer at Imajen Coaching. Jenny specializes in stress, resilience, and embodied self-development. In this session, she’ll discuss how past trauma impacts your current stress levels and provide tips to help regulate your nervous system. Jenny will conclude with a grounding exercise to help you feel more centered. Learn more about Jenny at Imajen Coaching.

Kairavi Vora, Homeopathic Therapist and Reiki Practitioner at Heal with Homeopathy. With extensive experience in clinical homeopathic practice, Kairavi treats a wide range of conditions, including respiratory issues, digestive ailments, female disorders, and allergies. She’ll share how homeopathy can offer emotional balance and stress relief, providing a natural way to restore calm during the busy holiday season. Learn more about Kairavi at Heal with Homeopathy.

We look forward to welcoming you to this insightful in-person event, where you’ll gain tools to help you thrive this holiday season!

summary: Grief is a part of life, we all experience it at some point but sometimes we get stuck in the emotion. Join us for an open discussion about our relationship with grief, how it impacts our life and simply be among people experiencing similar circumstances.
description:
After the success of our Embracing Mortality event in July, we recognised that there is a need for people to have a space to freely discuss their experiences with grief. The evening will be facilitated Liza Berenfeld,  a Death Doula and will also be joined by an occasional therapist from the health centre to offer support as needed.

Please note, this is not meant to replace personal therapy, it is a place for people within the community to gather, share and perhaps learn from each other.

About the evening:

We all love someone or something, which means we will be losing or have already gone through the loss.  Loss can be gradual and expected, or sudden and shocking. There is always a before and after the loss. Loss of any kind invites us to go deep into the garden of our soul and to meet the grief. The outer world at the same time keeps living at a usual quick pace, making no apologies for the griever.

Grief is the natural response to loss. We all grieve differently depending on biological, psychological, and social needs. Externally we can witness and express grief in mourning which is impacted by cultural, religious, traditional, and personal factors. But we all need a safe place, acceptance in grief, and care in transitional moments like learning to leave with grief.

Don’t stay alone!

We invite you to join us at our monthly healing circles “Holding our Grief Together” especially for people:

- who feel the need to be heard and seen in grief

- seeking support to move through grief together with others

- willing to share their story and support others as part of the healing process

What to expect?

Safe and tender environment to express your grief in the circle of other persons with relatable experiences of loss.

We will support you with:

- Discussing the physiology and spirituality of grief
- Participate in Grief moving exercises
- Sharing stories

summary: Time flies! It's been one incredible year of bringing natural medicine to The Hague, and we'd love for your to be a part of it. This special event is your opportunity to experience two unique therapies - as a special gift, we offer it for just €35. Treat yourself to a heartwarming energy boost.
description:
Join us for a boost of energy this winter by treating yourself to 2 therapeutic sessions of 30 minutes for the special price of €35!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_cf07311864824acd9884eca34b84ede3~mv2.png)

Allocations will be made on a first come first served basis on the event date.

Types of therapies include:

Acupuncture/pressure,  Homeopathy,  Foot Reflexology,  Kinesiology, Reiki or Energy Healing.

Click "MORE DETAILS' below for details and registration

To Register

The available time slots are noted below, however, you will receive a link to choose your time slot once you register. Please note, you will be re-directed to EventBrite to select your time slot.

9:00 -  10:15

10:30 - 11:45

13:00 - 14:15

14:30 - 15:45

Description

We are delighted to invite you to our 1-year Anniversary Celebration at The Hague Natural Health Centre. This milestone is all about you, our lovely community, who have made this journey possible.

Step into our serene space, designed with your well-being in mind, and treat yourself to a relaxing experience during the cold winter months. This is your moment to pause, breathe, and celebrate the gift of self-care. Unwind with a soothing cup of tea in our cozy living room area in between your rechargin  sessions.

Our mission has always been to offer therapies that increase your energy, nourish your body and nurture your spirit - naturally. This January, try something new. Join us in marking this special occasion - we can't wait to share an afternoon together.

NOTE: The sessions are meant to be a taster only and not a treatment. Our aim is to give your energy a boost and possibly assist you with minor acute complaints, these sessions are not meant to treat chronic complaints. Chronic illnesses require a properly scheduled appointment.

Allocations are based on first come first served basis - on the actual day. When you arrive, you can choose from the available therapies so be sure to arrive early.

Anniversary Celebration - Agenda

9:00 - 10:15	One-to-One Experiences

9:30 - 10:40 	Group: Pilgrim Circle

10:30 - 11:45 	One-to-One Experiences

11:00 - 12:30 	Group: Comforting Winter Wellness

13:00 - 14:15 	One-to-One Experiences

13:30 - 14:45	Constellations - Group Session

14:30 - 15:45 	One-to-One Experiences

One to One Session Descriptions:

Acupressure/Acupuncture

Acupuncture is based on Chinese medicine and works to unblock the meridians which are the energy pathways of the body. Instead of the use of needles along the meridians, this treatment will involve learning about various acupressure points that you can use to stimulate energy flow to areas of the body that you feel are experiencing stagnation. These points could range from controlling cravings to minor aches & pains and will be based on your needs.

Homeopathy

Homeopathy is a natural form of medicine in pills or liquid form that works gently with the body and without side-effects. Come and speak to one of our homeopaths about acute complaints such as injuries, exhaustion, overwhelm, coughs/colds or other minor acute conditions. This experience includes a homeopathic remedy, tissue salt or flower essence remedy depending on your unique symptoms.

Foot Reflexology

Reflexology is a therapeutic practice based on the principle that specific points on the feet correspond to different organs and systems in the body. By applying gentle pressure to these points we aim to balance the energy flow and stimulate the self-healing capacity of the body. Sit back and relax with a gentle foot massage while our Reflexologist offers you a reading of your feet.

Kinesiology

Systemic kinesiology is a holsitic health practice that uses muscle testing to identify and correct imbalances in the body. Muscle testing works directly with the body, ‘asking the body itself’ what makes it stronger and what weakens it. In this introduction, you will work with your kinesiologist to identify a pattern of stress that may be weakening you and which supplements or interventions might return your body to balance.

Reiki

Reiki is an ancient Japanese energy healing technique that brings about physical and emotional relief and wellbeing. Reiki works to subtly move and release the blockages that cause pain or illness within the body while amplifying one's ability to heal naturally. Reiki is a nurturing way to help detoxify and renew from a range of traumas to the system, including:  stress, injury, environmental toxins and use of pharmaceuticals. It is a gentle yet powerful treatment that takes place fully clothed.

Bio-Energy Healing

Bioenergy Healing is a non-invasive, holistic therapy that focuses on restoring balance to the body’s energy fields. Using energy healing techniques, the aim is to clear blockages and stimulate the body’s natural healing processes.

The therapy is conducted fully clothed, making it comfortable and accessible. Bioenergy healing is beneficial for reducing stress, boosting the immune system, alleviating chronic pain, and improving mental clarity. It is often used as a complementary therapy for conditions such as anxiety, depression, and fatigue, promoting overall well-being and resilience

Nutrition

Wondering how and where to start with changing your nutrition habits? Join our Nutritionist for some helpful tips on getting started in a way that is manageable and more likely to help you achieve your goals.  Many physical complaints can be alleviated with simple changes to the food you take in. This session is a helpful way to get started to a healthier you!

Group Session Descriptions

9:30 - 10:45  Pilgrim Circle

All the world’s a stage and all the men and women merely players.

They have their exits and their entrances, and one person in its time plays many parts’

(W. Shakespeare)

What is your role in life? How many are you playing? Which one is the part where you follow your heart while staying grounded and do what you want to do to both nourish yourself and contribute to the greater good? In this conscious awareness open pilgrim circle we explore easy going body language routines and mindful ways to enhance, balance and relax the unique energy systems you were gifted at the birth to support you in daily life.

English and Dutch spoken.

11:00 - 12:15  Comforting Winter Wellness

Days have grown shorter, and the darkness has crept in, now is the time to embrace the warmth and nourishment of wholesome, comforting meals. Supporting the immune system, mental health, bone health and vitamin D levels with clean protein and fibre rich foods, will be the focus of this session. Hosted by Audrey Dickinson, Nutritionist, she will present a cooking demo which offers nutritional tips to support you through the winter.

13:30 - 14:45  Constellations Group Session

This workshop is an interactive transformational session aimed to address self-acceptance, by helping women connect with their 4 basic Archetypes - the timeless, universal patterns that lie deep within each of us, shape our identities, guide our behaviours, and influence our relationships with the world. During this workshop, we will focus on the 4 basic ones: Mother (family, caregiver), Amazon (society, career), Maiden (inner Child, creativity), Aphrodite (emotions, sexuality).

Sadly, our modern fast-paced society often creates an internal conflict between who we are and who we feel we should be — an issue women are particularly vulnerable to. During the workshop, we will bring together different aspects of a woman’s personality using the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method that involves role-playing and representation, where stand-ins are asked to describe how they feel about the connection between the different Archetypes.

English-spoken.

Group Sessions will be hosted in a separate space to allow for more people and to keep the centre peaceful during the treatments.

We look forward to seeing you at the celebration of The Hague Natural Health Centre - 1 year anniversary!

During the workshop, we will bring together different aspects of a woman’s personality using the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method that involves role-playing and representation, where stand-ins are asked to describe how they feel about the connection between the different Archetypes.

We are delighted to invite you to our 1-year Anniversary Celebration at The Hague Natural Health Centre. This milestone is all about you, our lovely community, who have made this journey possible.

Step into our serene space, designed with your well-being in mind, and treat yourself to a relaxing experience during the cold winter months. This is your moment to pause, breathe, and celebrate the gift of self-care. Unwind with a soothing cup of tea in our cozy living room area in between your rechargin  sessions.

Our mission has always been to offer therapies that increase your energy, nourish your body and nurture your spirit - naturally. This January, try something new. Join us in marking this special occasion - we can't wait to share an afternoon together.

NOTE: The sessions are meant to be a taster only and not a treatment. Our aim is to give your energy a boost and possibly assist you with minor acute complaints, these sessions are not meant to treat chronic complaints. Chronic illnesses require a properly scheduled appointment.

Allocations are based on first come first served basis. Once you arrive at the check-in, we will let you choose from the available therapies so be sure to arrive on time.

Anniversary Celebration - Agenda

9:00 - 10:15	One-to-One Experiences

9:30 - 10:40 	Group: Pilgrim Circle

10:30 - 11:45 	One-to-One Experiences

One to One Session Descriptions:

Acupressure/Acupuncture

Acupuncture is based on Chinese medicine and works to unblock the meridians which are the energy pathways of the body. Instead of the use of needles along the meridians, this treatment will involve learning about various acupressure points that you can use to stimulate energy flow to areas of the body that you feel are experiencing stagnation. These points could range from controlling cravings to minor aches & pains and will be based on your needs.

Homeopathy

Homeopathy is a natural form of medicine in pills or liquid form that works gently with the body and without side-effects. Come and speak to one of our homeopaths about acute complaints such as injuries, exhaustion, overwhelm, coughs/colds or other minor acute conditions. This experience includes a homeopathic remedy, tissue salt or flower essence remedy depending on your unique symptoms.

Foot Reflexology

Reflexology is a therapeutic practice based on the principle that specific points on the feet correspond to different organs and systems in the body. By applying gentle pressure to these points we aim to balance the energy flow and stimulate the self-healing capacity of the body. Sit back and relax with a gentle foot massage while our Reflexologist offers you a reading of your feet.

Kinesiology

Systemic kinesiology is a holsitic health practice that uses muscle testing to identify and correct imbalances in the body. Muscle testing works directly with the body, ‘asking the body itself’ what makes it stronger and what weakens it. In this introduction, you will work with your kinesiologist to identify a pattern of stress that may be weakening you and which supplements or interventions might return your body to balance.

Reiki

Reiki is an ancient Japanese energy healing technique that brings about physical and emotional relief and wellbeing. Reiki works to subtly move and release the blockages that cause pain or illness within the body while amplifying one's ability to heal naturally. Reiki is a nurturing way to help detoxify and renew from a range of traumas to the system, including:  stress, injury, environmental toxins and use of pharmaceuticals. It is a gentle yet powerful treatment that takes place fully clothed.

Bio-Energy Healing

Bioenergy Healing is a non-invasive, holistic therapy that focuses on restoring balance to the body’s energy fields. Using energy healing techniques, the aim is to clear blockages and stimulate the body’s natural healing processes.

The therapy is conducted fully clothed, making it comfortable and accessible. Bioenergy healing is beneficial for reducing stress, boosting the immune system, alleviating chronic pain, and improving mental clarity. It is often used as a complementary therapy for conditions such as anxiety, depression, and fatigue, promoting overall well-being and resilience

Our inner critic often misleads us into giving up on our aspirations or blocking us from even taking small supportive steps in our lives. But not always. In this interactive workshop, you'll get intimate with your inner critic, learn how to discern between what's negative and useless chatter or reasonable and constructive concerns. You'll leave the workshop having practiced how to navigate your inner critic in a more supportive way and hopefully feeling clearer and lighter.  Expect humour, compassion and some good wholesome humanity.

Our mission has always been to offer therapies that increase your energy, nourish your body and nurture your spirit - naturally. This January, try something new. Join us in marking this special occasion - we can't wait to share an afternoon together.

NOTE: The one-to-one sessions are meant to be a taster only and not a treatment. Our aim is to give your energy a boost and possibly assist you with minor acute complaints, these sessions are not meant to treat chronic complaints. Chronic illnesses require a properly scheduled appointment.

Allocations are based on first come first served basis - on the actual day. When you arrive, you can choose from the available therapies so be sure to arrive early.

Anniversary Celebration - Agenda

9:00 - 10:15	One-to-One Experiences

9:30 - 10:40 	Group: Pilgrim Circle

10:30 - 11:45 	One-to-One Experiences

11:00 - 12:30 	Group: Comforting Winter Wellness

13:00 - 14:15 	One-to-One Experiences

13:30 - 14:45	Constellations - Group Session

14:30 - 15:45 	One-to-One Experiences

One to One Session Descriptions:

Acupressure/Acupuncture

Acupuncture is based on Chinese medicine and works to unblock the meridians which are the energy pathways of the body. Instead of the use of needles along the meridians, this treatment will involve learning about various acupressure points that you can use to stimulate energy flow to areas of the body that you feel are experiencing stagnation. These points could range from controlling cravings to minor aches & pains and will be based on your needs.

Homeopathy

Homeopathy is a natural form of medicine in pills or liquid form that works gently with the body and without side-effects. Come and speak to one of our homeopaths about acute complaints such as injuries, exhaustion, overwhelm, coughs/colds or other minor acute conditions. This experience includes a homeopathic remedy, tissue salt or flower essence remedy depending on your unique symptoms.

Foot Reflexology

Reflexology is a therapeutic practice based on the principle that specific points on the feet correspond to different organs and systems in the body. By applying gentle pressure to these points we aim to balance the energy flow and stimulate the self-healing capacity of the body. Sit back and relax with a gentle foot massage while our Reflexologist offers you a reading of your feet.

Kinesiology

Systemic kinesiology is a holsitic health practice that uses muscle testing to identify and correct imbalances in the body. Muscle testing works directly with the body, ‘asking the body itself’ what makes it stronger and what weakens it. In this introduction, you will work with your kinesiologist to identify a pattern of stress that may be weakening you and which supplements or interventions might return your body to balance.

Reiki

Reiki is an ancient Japanese energy healing technique that brings about physical and emotional relief and wellbeing. Reiki works to subtly move and release the blockages that cause pain or illness within the body while amplifying one's ability to heal naturally. Reiki is a nurturing way to help detoxify and renew from a range of traumas to the system, including:  stress, injury, environmental toxins and use of pharmaceuticals. It is a gentle yet powerful treatment that takes place fully clothed.

Bio-Energy Healing

Bioenergy Healing is a non-invasive, holistic therapy that focuses on restoring balance to the body’s energy fields. Using energy healing techniques, the aim is to clear blockages and stimulate the body’s natural healing processes.

The therapy is conducted fully clothed, making it comfortable and accessible. Bioenergy healing is beneficial for reducing stress, boosting the immune system, alleviating chronic pain, and improving mental clarity. It is often used as a complementary therapy for conditions such as anxiety, depression, and fatigue, promoting overall well-being and resilience

Nutrition

Wondering how and where to start with changing your nutrition habits? Join our Nutritionist for some helpful tips on getting started in a way that is manageable and more likely to help you achieve your goals.  Many physical complaints can be alleviated with simple changes to the food you take in. This session is a helpful way to get started to a healthier you!

Group Session Descriptions

9:30 - 10:45  Pilgrim Circle

All the world’s a stage and all the men and women merely players.

They have their exits and their entrances, and one person in its time plays many parts’

(W. Shakespeare)

What is your role in life? How many are you playing? Which one is the part where you follow your heart while staying grounded and do what you want to do to both nourish yourself and contribute to the greater good? In this conscious awareness open pilgrim circle we explore easy going body language routines and mindful ways to enhance, balance and relax the unique energy systems you were gifted at the birth to support you in daily life.

English and Dutch spoken.

11:00 - 12:15  Comforting Winter Wellness

Days have grown shorter, and the darkness has crept in, now is the time to embrace the warmth and nourishment of wholesome, comforting meals. Supporting the immune system, mental health, bone health and vitamin D levels with clean protein and fibre rich foods, will be the focus of this session. Hosted by Audrey Dickinson, Nutritionist, she will present a cooking demo which offers nutritional tips to support you through the winter.

13:30 - 14:45  Constellations Group Session

This workshop is an interactive transformational session aimed to address self-acceptance, by helping women connect with their 4 basic Archetypes - the timeless, universal patterns that lie deep within each of us, shape our identities, guide our behaviours, and influence our relationships with the world. During this workshop, we will focus on the 4 basic ones: Mother (family, caregiver), Amazon (society, career), Maiden (inner Child, creativity), Aphrodite (emotions, sexuality).

Sadly, our modern fast-paced society often creates an internal conflict between who we are and who we feel we should be — an issue women are particularly vulnerable to. During the workshop, we will bring together different aspects of a woman’s personality using the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method that involves role-playing and representation, where stand-ins are asked to describe how they feel about the connection between the different Archetypes.

English-spoken.

Group Sessions will be hosted in a separate space to allow for more people and to keep the centre peaceful during the treatments.

We look forward to seeing you at the celebration of The Hague Natural Health Centre - 1 year anniversary!

You'll leave the workshop having practiced how to navigate your inner critic in a more supportive way and hopefully feeling clearer and lighter.  Expect humour, compassion and some good wholesome humanity.

Days have grown shorter, and the darkness has crept in, now is the time to embrace the warmth and nourishment of wholesome, comforting meals. Supporting the immune system, mental health, bone health and vitamin D levels with clean protein and fibre rich foods, will be the focus of this session. Hosted by Audrey Dickinson, Nutritionist, she will present a cooking demo which offers nutritional tips to support you through the winter.

Group Sessions will be hosted in a separate space to allow for more people and to keep the centre peaceful during the treatments.

summary: Time flies! It's been one incredible year of bringing natural medicine to The Hague, and we'd love for your to be a part of it. This special event is your opportunity to experience two unique therapies - as a special gift, we offer it for just €35. Treat yourself to a heartwarming energy boost.
description:
Experience the Power of Natural Medicine

Join us as we celebrate 1 year of offering natural and complementary treatments in The Hague.

During this event, attendees will have 2 surprise one-on-one experiences from the various therapies offered at the Health Centre. Each taster will last approximately 30 minutes so you can expect to be there at about 75 minutes. Please indicate at least one type of taster that you would like to experience and we will do our best to accommodate your request. Ultimately, the experiences will be allocated on a first come, first served bases. In between your sessions, you can enjoy a cup of tea in our relaxing living room area.

NOTE: The sessions are meant to be a taster only and not a treatment. Our aim is to give your energy a boost and possibly assist you with minor acute complaints, these sessions are not meant to treat chronic complaints. Chronic illnesses require a properly scheduled appointment.

You can choose between 1 group session or 2 experiences during the registration.

Agenda

9:00 - 10:15	One-to-One Experiences

9:30 - 10:40 	Group: Pilgrim Circle

10:30 - 11:45 	One-to-One Experiences

11:00 - 12:30 	Group: Harnessing your Inner Critic

12:45 - 14:00 	Group: Comforting Winter Wellness

13:00 - 14:15 	One-to-One Experiences

14::15 - 15:30 	Group: Harnessing your Inner Critic

14:30 - 15:45 	One-to-One Experiences

16:00 - 17:15 	One-to-One Experiences

One to One Session Descriptions:

Acupressure

Acupuncture is based on Chinese medicine and works to unblock the meridians which are the energy pathways of the body. Instead of the use of needles along the meridians, this treatment will involve learning about various acupressure points that you can use to stimulate energy flow to areas of the body that you feel are experiencing stagnation. These points could range from controlling cravings to minor aches & pains and will be based on your needs.

Homeopathy

Homeopathy is a natural form of medicine in pills or liquid form that works gently with the body and without side-effects. Come and speak to one of our homeopaths about acute complaints such as injuries, exhaustion, overwhelm, coughs/colds or other minor acute conditions. This experience includes a homeopathic remedy, tissue salt or flower essence remedy depending on your unique symptoms.

Foot Reflexology

Reflexology is a therapeutic practice based on the principle that specific points on the feet correspond to different organs and systems in the body. By applying gentle pressure to these points we aim to balance the energy flow and stimulate the self-healing capacity of the body. Sit back and relax with a gentle foot massage while our Reflexologist offers you a reading of your feet.

Kinesiology

Systemic kinesiology is a holsitic health practice that uses muscle testing to identify and correct imbalances in the body. Muscle testing works directly with the body, ‘asking the body itself’ what makes it stronger and what weakens it. In this introduction, you will work with your kinesiologist to identify a pattern of stress that may be weakening you and which supplements or interventions might return your body to balance.

Reiki

Reiki is an ancient Japanese energy healing technique that brings about physical and emotional relief and wellbeing. Reiki works to subtly move and release the blockages that cause pain or illness within the body while amplifying one's ability to heal naturally. Reiki is a nurturing way to help detoxify and renew from a range of traumas to the system, including:  stress, injury, environmental toxins and use of pharmaceuticals. It is a gentle yet powerful treatment that takes place fully clothed.

Bio-Energy Healing

Bioenergy Healing is a non-invasive, holistic therapy that focuses on restoring balance to the body’s energy fields. Using energy healing techniques, the aim is to clear blockages and stimulate the body’s natural healing processes.

The therapy is conducted fully clothed, making it comfortable and accessible. Bioenergy healing is beneficial for reducing stress, boosting the immune system, alleviating chronic pain, and improving mental clarity. It is often used as a complementary therapy for conditions such as anxiety, depression, and fatigue, promoting overall well-being and resilience

All the world’s a stage and all the men and women merely players.

They have their exits and their entrances, and one person in its time plays many parts’

(W. Shakespeare)

What is your role in life? How many are you playing? Which one is the part where you follow your heart while staying grounded and do what you want to do to both nourish yourself and contribute to the greater good? In this conscious awareness open pilgrim circle we explore easy going body language routines and mindful ways to enhance, balance and relax the unique energy systems you were gifted at the birth to support you in daily life.

English and Dutch spoken.

description:
Start off 2025 with a gift for yourself! Discover the transformative power of Reiki with our 2-day group Level 1 Reiki training. Led by  Reiki Shihan, Sandra Delgado Quist, this course is ideal for anyone looking to use Reiki for their own personal healing and growth or as an addition to their existing therapeutic practice.

Sandra learned Reiki when her son was born and wasn't aware of how useful it was to help nurture and support her child. To this day - 18 years later, this little gift requiring nothing but your hands - keeps on giving.

Level 1 Reiki training provides you with the tools to improve your own mind and body and those of others. For many people, it is a life changing experience. Learning Reiki helps you understand how to work with your own energy and avoid being drained by others. There are no pre-requisites to learn Reiki. You only need an open mind, the willingness to learn and your two hands. The course includes:

- Reiki origins and principles
- Giving & receiving Reiki
- Energy circulation massage
- Tips for maintaining your own energy

This is a two day event and attendance at both days is required. Also important to note,  Reiki includes direct touch, and practical sessions form part of the courses. Students will be expected to give and receive Reiki treatments as an important part of the training.

Course fees include 2 days of learning and practicing Reiki, a Reiki booklet, a Reiki certificate of completion and drinks & snacks throughout the day. Lunch and VAT are not included.

title: Constellation Workshop: My Health

summary: An exploratory Constellations Workshop to uncover the hidden dynamics behind your health and vitality. We will look beyond symptoms into the deeper connections between body, mind, and family history, shining light on the areas that most need attention.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

My Health

We often take our health for granted — until our body reminds us otherwise.

Fatigue, recurring symptoms, or chronic conditions can all be signals that something deeper is asking for attention. In this exploratory Constellations Workshop, we will look beneath the surface of symptoms and listen to what your body may be trying to say:

❓Which unspoken loyalties, ancestral patterns or hidden family burdens can be showing up as illness or fatigue?

❓How do you unconsciously limit your own energy and resilience?

❓What would help your body feel safe enough to restore its natural balance?

🌿 The power of Constellations

This workshop is not about quick fixes. It is about bringing to light the patterns that quietly influence your body’s state of health and energy.

Systemic constellations reveal subconscious dynamics that often remain invisible: unresolved emotions, ancestral burdens, or loyalty to those who suffered before us.

During the workshop, we will:

🌀 Explore the connection between your inner world and your physical state

🌀 Map out where life energy becomes blocked or depleted

🌀 Observe how family dynamics and beliefs affect health and vitality

🌀 Open a pathway to greater awareness and balance

✅What to expect:

The Systemic Constellations technique involves role-playing and representation. Stand-ins will be asked to describe how they feel in relation to figures representing your connection with Health.The purpose is diagnostic, not instant healing — allowing you to see subconscious processes as if in a mirror. You will gain clarity about what is shaping your health today and what may need attention to restore your energy.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in uncovering hidden dynamics, releasing inherited burdens, and reconnecting with their natural vitality.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ Come as you are, with curiosity and openness. We will hold a grounded and compassionate space where hidden dynamics can be seen — and your path to greater health can begin to unfold.

title: Enhancing your Therapeutic Practice: Integrating Homeopathy & Kinesiology
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
price_text: Enhance your practice | More info | €295.00 | Sale ended
registration_text: See other events
summary: Unlock the power of homeopathy and kinesiology (applied muscle testing) to elevate your therapeutic practice in this  2-day hands-on workshop designed for holistic practitioners. This in an introduction to kinesiology and homeopathy for use in your own practice.
description:
Unlock the power of homeopathy and kinesiology (applied muscle testing) to elevate your therapeutic practice in this  2-day hands-on workshop designed for holistic practitioners. Learn essential homeopathy skills, including the application of first aid and other foundational remedies that can seamlessly complement your existing services. Discover key remedies and flower essences for common emotional challenges that you encounter with your clients in the scope of practice, like vulnerability, grief, and shock.

In addition, you'll be introduced to applied muscle testing (kinesiology) to help guide remedy selection, whether you are using homeopathy or something else. The applied muscle testing portion will focus on learning how to test  major muscles and to ensure those muscles are responding appropriately. We will also cover how to use yourself as a surrogate for testing your client, when their muscles are not firing as expected. We will incorporate a technique that allows you to explore the nature of an external injury and make an informed assessment about remedy selection. And finally, we will explore the power of food testing to support your clients with digestive and dietary challenges.

This workshop is geared towards people already in the therapuetic practice who want to enhance their existing practice and add to their toolbox. You can read more about the hosts of the workshop below:

Sandra  Quist is an accredited Homeopath, Reiki practitioner & teacher and  founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre. She spent four years  studying at The School of Homeopathy in Stroud, UK, and completed a  three year postgraduate course at the Dynamis School for Advanced  Homeopathy in Ireland. She completed her Reiki practitioner and teacher  training at the Jikiden Reiki Institute in Kyoto, Japan. Sandra  is passionate about teaching and empowering people to take control of  their own health. In this workshop, she will teach practitioners how to recognise common homeopathic remedies that can be useful within their own practice. She will also offer tips on recognising tissue salt deficiencies in the body and an introduction to flower essences in their practice.

Rebecca  Winter works as an HR professional in a tech company while maintaining a  private practice as a Health Coach and Kinesiologist. She helps people  through Life Transitions to (re)gain and (re)discover their own vitality  and inner resources. This can include recovery from burnout, reclaiming  post-pregnancy well-being, bouncing back from adrenal fatigue, making  friends with menopause as well as adjacent support for a life-changing  or threatening diagnosis.  Rebecca uses a combination of Health Coaching, Systematic Kinesiology  (Applied Muscle Testing), and The Body Code as her main tools to support  individuals in moving toward health. When clients present with extreme  imbalance and persistent inflammation based conditions - she leverages  the Bengston Method as part of her treatment toolkit. In this workshop Rebecca will teach you to use muscle testing to enhance your own therapeutic practice.

Both therapists hold regular office hours at The Hague Natural Health Centre, we look forward to sharing an enriching weekend together learning and adding to your existing toolbox.

summary: During the workshop, we will bring together different aspects of a woman’s personality using the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method that involves role-playing and representations.
description:
Constellations Workshop

FEMALE ARCHETYPES

This workshop is an interactive transformational session aimed to address self-acceptance, by helping women connect with their 4 basic Archetypes - the timeless, universal patterns that lie deep within each of us, shape our identities, guide our behaviours, and influence our relationships with the world. During this workshop, we will focus on the 4 basic ones: Mother (family, caregiver), Amazon (society, career), Maiden (inner Child, creativity), Aphrodite (emotions, sexuality).

Sadly, our modern fast-paced society often creates an internal conflict between who we are and who we feel we should be — an issue women are particularly vulnerable to. During the workshop, we will bring together different aspects of a woman’s personality using the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method that involves role-playing and representation, where stand-ins are asked to describe how they feel about the connection between the different Archetypes. English-spoken.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva,  a trained Constellations therapist who regularly holds interactive workshops, addressing the  inner aspects of the human personality (such as Inner Child / Parent / Adult, or the Archetypes) in her sessions. Through visual representation, Family Constellations techniques support participants in uncovering hidden dynamics, healing past wounds, and creating more harmonious relationships within themselves and with others.

Join us for an afternoon of discovery, connection, and scent-based storytelling!
