description:
Constellations Workshop

### HEALING THE INNER CHILD

#### This interactive transformational workshop offers a safe space to reconnect with, nurture, and heal your Inner Child, an immersive session that will help you to:

✅ Release Emotional Blocks – discover hidden dynamics within your family system that may be affecting your current relationships and self-perception.

✅ Transform Pain into Strength – create a safe space to acknowledge and nurture your Inner Child.

✅  Restore Inner Balance – by identifying, reconnecting with, and accepting the unmet needs from childhood that still influence your adult life.

##### Unhealed childhood wounds often manifest in repeating patterns—such as self-sabotage, relationship difficulties, or people-pleasing tendencies. By bringing awareness to these dynamics, you can consciously shift them and create healthier, more fulfilling ways of relating to yourself and others. This workshop offers a sacred, supportive environment where healing unfolds naturally. You will leave with a renewed connection to yourself, a sense of inner peace, and practical tools to continue nurturing your Inner Child beyond the session.

##### 

##### During this workshop, we will employ the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method developed by Bert Hellinger and based on the idea that many of our struggles — whether emotional, relational, or even physical — stem from unconscious loyalties, traumas, or entanglements within our family lineage.

##### Join us on this journey of self-discovery and transformation. Your Inner Child is waiting to be seen, heard, and embraced. 💛

##### No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your willingness to explore and heal. English-spoken.

##### 

##### This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly holds interactive workshops, addressing the inner aspects of the human personality (such as Inner Child / Parent / Adult, or the Archetypes). description:
### Spring & Ayurveda: Lighten up and Energise with Archana Munot

Ayurveda refers to spring as the Kapha season—when the body naturally sheds the heaviness accumulated during winter. According to the Ayurvedic ancient text Charak Samhita, Kapha builds up in the colder months and liquefies as the sun’s warmth increases, impacting digestion and metabolism.

The ancient science of Ayurveda promotes general wellness, helps increase energy, manages stress by balancing the doshas of Vata, Pitta, and  Kapha, and incorporates easy techniques like mindful diet, herbal supplements, and regular self-care routines.

Expert Vaidya from Archana Munot of Maharishi Ayurveda Europe B.V. will offer holistic wellness solutions, especially for the spring season.

Don't miss an opportunity to sign up for an individual Vaidya consultation after the lecture. The consultation will help you transition into the season feeling lighter, more energized, and in harmony with nature.

title: Constellation Workshop: Like Mother, Like Daughter
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Mom is the first and most important connection in our lives. We invite you to explore this relationship through the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a powerful therapeutic method that gives insights into our subconsciousness.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Like Mother, Like Daughter

During this interactive workshop, we will explore the deep connection we have with our mother, that lays the foundation not only for our emotional and psychological health, but also for how we perceive the world and build relationships with ourselves:

✨ Our ability to trust the world

As children, if we felt loved, cared for, and nurtured by our mother, we developed a fundamental sense of Trust – that the world is a safe place where we can be ourselves and where our needs will be met. However, if our relationship with our mother was cold, unpredictable, or filled with anxiety, the world may start to feel hostile, making it difficult for us to trust others.

✨ Our self-esteem

Our mother is our first "mirror" and the way she looked at us shaped our self-perception. If we were praised, respected, and encouraged, we grow up with confidence. But if we were criticized, compared to others, or overlooked, we may spend our lives struggling with the belief that we are not good enough.

✨ Our ability to give and receive love

Through our mother, we first learn how to love and be loved. If she was warm, open, and accepting, we naturally carry this experience into our future relationships. However, if her love was conditional "I only love you if you behave well" we may grow up believing that love must be earned rather than freely given.

✨ Our relationship with money and success

If our mother held limiting beliefs such as “money is only earned through hard work,” “it’s safer to stay unnoticed,” or “wealthy people are bad,” we may unconsciously fear success or financial prosperity — even if we consciously strive for them. If she supported us and had faith in our abilities, we move forward with confidence.

During this workshop, we will employ the CONSTELLATIONS technique, a therapeutic method developed by Bert Hellinger and based on the idea that many of our struggles — whether emotional, relational, or even physical — stem from unconscious loyalties, traumas, or entanglements within our family lineage.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly holds interactive sessions. This unique technique provides a window into the subconscious, revealing hidden dynamics and patterns while allowing them to be rewritten. By working with deep emotional and energetic connections, we tap into the transformative power of constellations—helping to bring these patterns to light and reshape them.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your willingness to explore and heal.

Join us on this journey of self-discovery and transformation ❤️

summary: Have you ever considered how impactful your personal and work spaces are to your health? Keeping your space clear and clean is incredibly important and directly impacts our ability to focus and feel motivated. Join us to learn about the ancient practice of Feng Shui and sacred spaces.
description:
Creating Sacred Spaces

This event is hosted by Darina Veen-Kassova, Feng Shui Specialist and Sandra Quist, Homeopath and Founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre. Darina will bring her expertise about Feng Shui and helping you to check your own home or office. Sandra will contribute to the discussions about energy in your space and how altars can help the energy of your spaces.

The art of Feng Shui is about letting the energy flow freely throughout your home and your life so you can thrive.

Ancient natural healers always understood the effect of an environment on an individual’s health and well-being. Special ceremonies were performed to bless a new home, in case of illness the entire environment was cleansed and healed with herbs.

Your home reflects your inner self and is an extension of your unique energy. Now, imagine if you had the tools to instantly transform your home into a haven of abundance, vitality, and nourishment that inspires you.

Feng Shui is offering opportunities to revitalize your home bringing more clarity, joy and focus into your daily life.

During the workshop Feng Shui expert Darina Veen with many years of experience in Feng Shui teaching will give you tools to discover how to intentionally harness the energy of your home, creating a natural flow that attracts everything you desire.

She will guide you step by step in enhancing the energy of your home and transforming it into a healing Sacred Space that radiates positive energy.

The workshop has three parts:

Part 1

Energetic Cleansing

Powerful techniques to clear stagnant energy in your home, release old blockages and welcome fresh abundance into your life. You learn to use the tools and set a powerful intention.

Part 2

Bagua Tool Application

How to master the art of directing energy in your home with the essential Bagua tool. You learn how to apply the Bagua (the Feng Shui Map) in your home, infuse energy and enhance vitality in key areas like the bedroom, kitchen, living space and office fostering improvements in health, relationships and creativity.

Part 3

Creating an altar

A home altar can generate energy that can keep an entire home balanced and clear. It can be a highly personal representation of what is most important to you, your hopes, dreams, joys, sorrows and your connection with wisdom of ancestors. You discover how to create a home altar that lifts your heart every time you look at it.

After the workshop you will be able to work with the flow of energy in your home so you can create space for new opportunities and greater abundance  pouring into your life.

Register, come and enjoy an evening full of new learnings!

Note:

Bring the floorplan of your home with you!

title: Constellations Workshop: Balancing Yin & Yang
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary:
During this workshop, we will explore the dynamic relationship between the
Masculine and Feminine energies within you — and use CONSTELLATIONS work to

description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Balancing Yin & Yang

Within each of us lives a dance of opposites: the soft and the strong, the intuitive and the logical, the receptive and the active. These forces are known as Yin and Yang, our Feminine and Masculine energies. When they fall out of sync, we experience

tension, confusion, or burnout. When they flow together, we feel grounded, clear, and whole.

This interactive transformational workshop offers a safe space to explore how these energies support, challenge, and shape your inner world. Through guided constellation work, we will bring these inner forces to life, allowing you to:

☯️ Connect with the Yin & Yang energies within you

☯️ Recognize where imbalance between them may be affecting your life

☯️ Reclaim the wisdom of the opposites

☯️ Experience integration as a living, breathing dance

This workshop invites you to start deeper listening to your nature, in order to move from inner conflict to conscious collaboration.

When Yin & Yang are out of balance, it often shows up in subtle yet persistent ways — feeling stuck in over-responsibility, emotional overwhelm, chronic fatigue, difficulty setting boundaries, or an inner sense of disconnection from one’s own needs and desires. These imbalances are often rooted in unconscious loyalties, family dynamics, or cultural conditioning.

Constellation work offers a powerful way to make the invisible visible. This therapeutic method was developed by Bert Hellinger in early 1960s and is based on the idea that externalizing processes in our subconsciousness into the physical space and observing them helps uncover hidden patterns that keep us looping in the same behaviors. This embodied awareness opens a space for change — allowing you to reposition your inner system, release outdated roles, and invite a more fluid and nourishing balance between Yin & Yang.

No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary for this workshop – only your willingness to explore and heal. English-spoken.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly holds interactive workshops, addressing the inner aspects of the human personality. Through visual representation, System Constellations techniques support participants in uncovering hidden dynamics, healing past wounds, and creating more harmonious relationships within themselves and with others.

Join us on this journey of self-discovery and transformation.

Feel the Yin-Yang harmony as a convergence, a breathing movement, a dance 🌸

title: Soul Writing Journey:  A Two Part Reading Circle
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary:
What happens when your soul begins to stir? 

In a two-part evening circle, we’ll explore Jonathan Livingston Seagull by Richard Bach—a  poetic parable about freedom, individuality, and the courage to follow your inner calling.  

Day 1: September 19
Day 2: October 10
description:
What happens when your soul begins to stir?

In a two-part evening circle, we’ll explore Jonathan Livingston Seagull by Richard Bach—a  poetic parable about freedom, individuality, and the courage to follow your inner calling.  Through reading, reflective dialogue, and autobiographical writing, participants are invited  to reconnect with what moves their soul.

This is not a traditional book club—no need to read the whole book in advance. We journey  together through selected passages, letting them open inner space for personal insight.

In the spirit of The Hague as an international city, participants are encouraged to read the  book (or parts of it) in their own language if they wish, and to bring their cultural or personal  lens into the circle. This shared story becomes a bridge across backgrounds and  experiences—a way to listen deeply, soul to soul.

Each session blends meditative presence, group conversation, and creative writing.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e14e96_4a12fce0ea814d5fb1c0ae549627f38c~mv2.png)

September 19th - Session 1: “Learning to Fly”

• Reading selected passages from Jonathan Livingston Seagull

• Exploring soul longing, inner rebellion, and the call to freedom

• Writing: a memory of when your soul first “moved” or whispered

October 10th - Session 2: “Becoming the Teacher”

• Reading: Jonathan’s return and his guidance of others

• Dialogue around legacy, quiet leadership, and living your soul’s truth

• Writing: a letter from your present self to your younger soul, or vice versa

For whom

For anyone seeking soulful nourishment, creative reflection, and a gentle space to share  their inner journey. No writing or reading experience needed—only curiosity and presence.  All nationalities and languages welcome.

About the Facilitator

Ingrid is a writer, meditation teacher and guide in personal transformation. With a deep  interest in the meeting point between soul, story and self-awareness, she creates spaces  where people can reflect, reconnect, and remember who they are. Her approach is gentle,  intuitive and grounded—inviting participants to listen deeply, speak authentically, and  honour their own journey. She has hosted circles for many years and works across language  and cultural boundaries to help people find meaning through words and presence.

summary: How’s your relationship with money? Are you over-spending? Or holding on too tightly? In this Constellations Workshop, we’ll explore the subconscious patterns that shape your financial behaviours today.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

The Energy of Money

✨ Money is energy. And like any energy, it flows best when it’s in balance — giving and receiving, saving and spending, trusting and letting go.

During this workshop, we’ll tap beyond what you consciously “know”:

❓What beliefs did you inherit around money, success, and self-worth?

❓Is your flow blocked somewhere — and why?

You may have read all the books about abundance, mindset, manifestation.

And yet — still live from a place of fear or scarcity.

Because the truth is: it’s not just about how much you know.

It’s about how deeply you allow yourself to receive.

With joy. With ease. With safety in your body.

🌿 The power of Constellations

This session is an invitation to step into your natural power of abundance and reconnect with your essence — the part of you that knows how to receive with grace and flow.

This exploratory diagnostic experience is designed to illuminate what is currently shaping your relationship with money. It’s not about resolving or healing everything on the spot. It’s about seeing clearly what was previously hidden.

Systemic constellations are a powerful way of revealing inner dynamics that often operate outside of conscious awareness. Many of our money patterns are influenced by inner parts that are in conflict, inherited beliefs, or unprocessed family dynamics.

During the workshop, we will:

🌀 Bring internal voices and dynamics into view

🌀 Map out where your flow might be blocked or leaking

🌀 Observe how inherited patterns or emotional loyalties shape your current behaviour

🌀 Begin to understand — not yet resolve — what needs attention

✅ What to expect:

The Systemic Constellations technique involves role-playing and representation, and during this workshop stand-ins will be asked to describe how they feel about the connection between different figures that represent your connection with the Energy of Money.

The main goal is not the healing as such – it is the diagnostics, allowing you to take a look at the processes in your subconscious mind, as if you were looking at yourself in the mirror.

We will uncover what’s really driving your relationship with money — and begin to shift it into a more harmonious, empowered state.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly holds interactive sessions. This unique technique provides a window into the subconscious, by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, System Constellations techniques support participants in uncovering hidden dynamics, healing past wounds, and creating more harmonious relationships within themselves and with others.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

Join us on this journey of self-discovery and transformation. Let’s co-create this safe, respectful, and confidential space together.❇️

title: Creative Parenting: Raising Ourselves to Raise Our Children
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
price_text: General Admission | €15.00 | +€0.38 ticket service fee | Sold Out
registration_text: See other events
summary: An experiential workshop for parents seeking insight, connection, and emotional growth
description:
Do you long to support your child’s emotional well-being in a way that also nurtures your own? Are you curious about how your inner life—as a parent—shapes your relationship with your child?

Join us for a heart-opening workshop exploring the power of imaginative parenting. In this session, we’ll look at how deepening our own emotional awareness can transform not only how we raise our children, but how we relate to ourselves.

We’ll use the creative, intuitive practice of guided imagery—a gentle but profound method developed at the School of Images®—to explore the emotional patterns, stories, and beliefs we may carry from our own childhood, and how these may unconsciously shape our parenting.

Guided imagery is a powerful tool for personal growth. Through short, imaginal exercises (that feel more like daydreams than effortful meditations), we bypass overthinking and drop into a place of clarity and emotional truth. It’s a way of seeing with the inner eye—of accessing deep insight, even when words fall short.

These same practices, adapted for children through the DreamKids® program, support emotional resilience, creativity, and the development of inner resources. Children naturally live in their imaginations—this is their native language. When parents learn to “speak” that language, it opens the door to connection, healing, and joy.

In this warm, welcoming space, we’ll:

- Practice a few guided imagery exercises for personal insight
- Reflect on what arises in a safe, non-judgmental space
- Explore how imagery can be used with children to foster emotional strength and confidence
- Reconnect with our own sense of imagination, play, and inner wisdom

Whether you’re a parent, caregiver, or simply interested in conscious personal development, you’re warmly welcome. No experience with imagery or meditation is needed—just an open heart and a willingness to explore.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e14e96_a3fe677f1ad149a8a844e629d5ddc416~mv2.jpeg)

Guest speaker is Sheona McEwan, a special needs teacher, counselor, and co-founder of DreamKids®, a program that brings Imagery to children and families around the world. Sheona teaches internationally through the School of Images® and works locally in The Hague with children and families from international schools. Her work integrates education, psychology, and imagery to help both children and parents grow from the inside out.

Hosted at The Hague Natural Health Centre, this workshop aligns with the centre’s holistic philosophy: healing begins with awareness, and the emotional and energetic well-being of parents is deeply interconnected with that of their children.

title: Soul Writing Journey:  A Two Part Reading Circle
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary:
What happens when your soul begins to stir? 

In a two-part evening circle, we’ll explore Jonathan Livingston Seagull by Richard Bach—a  poetic parable about freedom, individuality, and the courage to follow your inner calling.  

Day 1: September 19
Day 2: October 10
description:
What happens when your soul begins to stir?

In a two-part evening circle, we’ll explore Jonathan Livingston Seagull by Richard Bach—a  poetic parable about freedom, individuality, and the courage to follow your inner calling.  Through reading, reflective dialogue, and autobiographical writing, participants are invited  to reconnect with what moves their soul.

This is not a traditional book club—no need to read the whole book in advance. We journey  together through selected passages, letting them open inner space for personal insight.

In the spirit of The Hague as an international city, participants are encouraged to read the  book (or parts of it) in their own language if they wish, and to bring their cultural or personal  lens into the circle. This shared story becomes a bridge across backgrounds and  experiences—a way to listen deeply, soul to soul.

Each session blends meditative presence, group conversation, and creative writing.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e14e96_4a12fce0ea814d5fb1c0ae549627f38c~mv2.png)

September 19th - Session 1: “Learning to Fly”

• Reading selected passages from Jonathan Livingston Seagull

• Exploring soul longing, inner rebellion, and the call to freedom

• Writing: a memory of when your soul first “moved” or whispered

October 10th - Session 2: “Becoming the Teacher”

• Reading: Jonathan’s return and his guidance of others

• Dialogue around legacy, quiet leadership, and living your soul’s truth

• Writing: a letter from your present self to your younger soul, or vice versa

For whom

For anyone seeking soulful nourishment, creative reflection, and a gentle space to share  their inner journey. No writing or reading experience needed—only curiosity and presence.  All nationalities and languages welcome.

About the Facilitator

Ingrid is a writer, meditation teacher and guide in personal transformation. With a deep  interest in the meeting point between soul, story and self-awareness, she creates spaces  where people can reflect, reconnect, and remember who they are. Her approach is gentle,  intuitive and grounded—inviting participants to listen deeply, speak authentically, and  honour their own journey. She has hosted circles for many years and works across language  and cultural boundaries to help people find meaning through words and presence.

My Health

description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony — The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the ancient Munay-Ki rites from the Andean Shamans, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women in The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a female shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creators of our destinies and deepest longings.

During the ceremony, participants are gently guided to help release pain and sorrow held within the womb, with the aim of restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

- The ceremony lasts approximately 60-90 minutes
- Limited to 13 women for an intimate and nurturing circle
- Bring only yourself and your wish to heal your womb
- Come prepared to share openly and receive in sisterhood
- Note:  Some women can experience minor symptoms after the ceremony such as heat in the womb or a change in their cycle, this is a good sign, a sort of clearing out and should subside within a few days.
- (Optional) Wear something that makes you feel feminine or honours your divine femininity

This ceremony will be offered regularly at The Hague Natural Health Centre, inviting women to reconnect with their innate feminine power and the healing wisdom of the Earth.

🌸 Let’s connect to Mother Earth, heal our wombs, and begin to create our own destiny..

description:
Experience the Transformative Power of Sound Healing

Sound healing is a therapeutic practice that uses vibrational frequencies from instruments like singing bowls, gongs, and chimes to restore harmony in the body and mind. These soothing sounds help reduce stress, promote deep relaxation, and support emotional and physical well-being by aligning your energy.

During a sound healing session, vibrations gently guide you into a meditative state, encouraging the release of tension and balancing your inner rhythms. Many people report feeling lighter, calmer, and more centered after just one session.

Curious to experience it yourself? Join our Sound Healing evening and let the calming frequencies wash over you. Whether you're seeking stress relief, better sleep, or simply a moment of peace, this is your opportunity to explore the benefits firsthand. Come relax, recharge, and discover the healing power of sound!

Led by Joël Van der Putten, of Divine Tuning. Joël's mission is to inspire people with a combination of sound, music and ritual work. He understands that by working through sound, directly on these levels, the healing power of the body is activated along with the higher consciousness.

description:
### Learn Reiki: gentle, powerful, and yours for life

Ready to experience the simplest kind of magic? ✨

Join Jikiden Reiki Shihan, Sandra Delgado Quist for our 2-day Level 1 Reiki training — a heart-centred journey into healing energy that anyone can learn. Whether you’re seeking a self-care tool for you and your family, or you’re a therapist looking to expand your healing toolkit, this sacred weekend is for you.

Reiki is gentle yet incredibly powerful — a lifelong practice you can begin using immediately. Within Sandra's own practice, people are always drawn to Reiki’s simplicity, softness, and effectiveness. All you need are your hands, your time, and the willingness to hold sacred space for others. Learn in the serene surroundings of The Hague Natural Health Centre, filled with calming plant and crystal energies that it's like a mini-retreat for yourself. 🪷

- Key hand placements for giving and receiving Reiki
- Technique for calming the nervous system down & resetting fight or flight

- How to develop your personal practice
- Creating and holding sacred space for yourself and others
- Interactive hands-on practice (fully clothed, gentle touch)
- A beautiful hand-written certificate from the Jikiden Reiki Institute in Japan (ordered after completion)

### Important to know: 💫

- Cost of the 2 day course is 295 euro - a deposit of 75 euro is due at registration
- Balance is due 1 week after registration
- This is a two-day course; attendance on both days is required.
- A delicious Japanese Onigiri lunch on Sunday only is included - please provide your dietary needs in the notes at registration. Please plan to bring your lunch on Saturday.

Bonus:  For attendee's of this training, free admittance to the next 'Homeopathy for the Home' online workshop is included. This is a 2 hour introduction to using homeopathy and Schuessler Tissue Salts for first aid, minor complaints and natural energy boosts. It is one of Sandra's popular online courses and really supports people who want to take their health into their own hands using natural medicine.

Start remembering your innate ability to heal — and share that gift with your friends and family. It’s the most meaningful gift you can give yourself. 💖

title: Your Individual Constellation Session
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
price_text: General Admission | €55.00 | +€1.38 ticket service fee | Sold Out
registration_text: See other events
summary: This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS

Personal Constellation Session

✨ Systemic Constellations are a powerful tool to reveal what lies beneath the surface — whether it’s in family relationships, work dynamics, health, or even creativity. By giving form to what usually remains hidden, new perspectives and solutions emerge.

This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night (at 17:30, 18:30, 19:30). You can book a slot at your convenience to work on your question with the therapist.

This technique will offer a safe space for a deep and focused exploration of your personal theme. The examples of questions can be:

🌀 Relationships — Why do I always end up in the same type of relationship? How can I rebuild trust after a breakup?

🌀 Career or business challenges — Should I stay in my current job or take the risk of starting something new? What blocks me from stepping into leadership with confidence?

🌀 Health and energy — Why do I feel so tired all the time? What can I do to support my body in healing and regaining strength?

🌀 Life direction & creativity — I feel stuck and don’t know what I want next. How can I move forward with my project, book, or dream that keeps stalling?

✅ The Power of Constellations:

Each individual constellation will be conducted one-on-one using a constellation board — a visual and symbolic tool that allows key elements of your question (Figures) to be placed and observed in relation to one another. As the pieces move and interact, inner dynamics, emotional tensions, and subconscious patterns begin to reveal themselves. The board makes visible what the mind cannot yet see — how energies, relationships, and internal parts influence your choices and state of being.

This session is diagnostic and exploratory in nature. The focus is not on immediate resolution, but on bringing hidden dynamics to the surface so they can be seen clearly. By shining light on what operates in the subconscious, you gain the awareness needed to take more conscious, empowered steps forward in your life.

This evening will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions, in-person and online. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections, supporting participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with greater clarity.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to join this special evening of exploration and discovery.

title: Constellation Workshop: Life Transitions
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: Are you facing a turning point — a breakup, a move abroad, a career shift, or simply questioning the path you’re on? This exploratory Constellations Workshop will help you see the hidden dynamics influencing your choices and connect with your inner guidance to face Life Transitions with confidence.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Life Transitions

✨ Every new chapter in life begins with a Step — yet sometimes the decision feels overwhelming. Should I stay or should I go? Change direction or keep moving on? Wait, or leap forward?

This workshop is for you if:

🌀 You recently ended something important — a relationship, left a job, or moved abroad — and feel like the ground under your feet has shifted

🌀 You are torn between staying safe and stepping into the unknown: should you take the risk of starting a business? pursuing a passion? or moving to a new city?

🌀 You often find yourself asking: What now? Where do I go from here?

The Life Transitions Workshop offers a space where you can reconnect with your own inner guidance.

From this place, your inner truth becomes visible and your next step begins to emerge.

Through systemic constellations, hidden dynamics around fear, loyalty, or expectation are revealed — helping you see what has been blocking your movement and where your energy naturally wants to flow.

During the workshop, we will:

💫 Bring to light the inner dynamics influencing your choices

💫 Explore loyalties or fears that may hold you back from change

💫 Observe what strengthens you and what drains you when facing decisions

💫 Open space for clarity, courage, and your authentic next step

✅ What to expect:Through the Systemic Constellations technique, other participants (Representatives) step into roles that represent inner parts of the Questioner (you). Their responses act as reflections of the unseen dynamics around your choices. This exploration is diagnostic in nature — a way of looking into a mirror that shows what lies beneath the surface, often opening space for clarity and direction.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious, by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with their authentic path forward.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to step into this circle of exploration and let your Next Step reveal itself in a safe, respectful, and confidential space.

location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: In this workshop we will introduce you to dream work and different ways of working with dreams. We will look at the importance of symbols, culture, and personal associations as they show up in dreams, and how they can help  connect us to our psyche.
description:
WORKING WITH YOUR DREAMS

"The dream is a little hidden door in the innermost and most secret recesses of the soul, opening into that cosmic night which was psyche long before there was any ego-consciousness, and which will remain psyche no matter how far our ego-consciousness extends."

C.G. Jung "The Meaning of Psychology for Modern Man" (1933)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_a7df8d2f23f54cb1881ab9c562550b67~mv2.jpg)

Are you curious about dreams and dreaming?

Do you wonder what your dreams might be trying to show you?

During this event, Jungian-oriented Psychologist and Art Therapist Cammi Manchur will walk you through the different ways you can approach working with your dreams. There are many ways to look at dreams and this event will focus mainly on a Jungian approach to dreamwork. There will be a particular emphasis on how to approach dreamwork in a safe and thoughtful way that honours the dream.

Due to the personal nature of dream work we will not be exploring participants dreams; however, we will go through a few dreams from case studies together in order to get a feel for working with symbols and the unconscious. This will be an informative and experiential event with time for questions at the end.

You can reach Cammi directly via email at cammi@creativeconnectiontherapy.ca

title: The Good, the Bad, & the Fungi
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 Den Haag, Netherlands
price_text: General Admission | More info | €15.00 | Sold Out
registration_text: See other events
summary: Itchy skin? Stubborn candida? Join us in the next Living Room Chat as we explore Candida, Athlete's Foot and other fungal infections. Come away with tips on how to bring balance to your body naturally.
description:
Join us for the next edition of "The Living Room Chat" as we discuss the microscopic, mildly uncomfortable, and surprising  fungi that call our bodies home. Hosted by Sandra Quist,  Homeopath, and Audrey Dickinson,  Nutritionist, this interactive session shines a light on the hidden world of fungal infections — from the inside out.

Sandra will open the session by introducing the intriguing variety of fungi that can affect the body — both internally and externally. You'll learn about:

- 🍄 Internal imbalances such as Candida overgrowth
- 🦶 External nuisances like athlete’s foot and ringworm
- 🔍 Common symptoms of fungal infections such as itching, fatigue, or brain fog

She’ll also share 🌱 natural topical solutions and 💫 energetic remedies designed to support your body’s ability to rebalance and heal from within.

Next, Audrey will explore how what you eat (and sometimes what you crave) can either feed or fight fungi. Discover how:

- 🍬 Sugar, alcohol, and stress turn your gut into a fungal playground
- 🦠 Candida albicans can be a friendly resident—or a chaotic houseguest
- 🧘‍♀️ Gut and vaginal balance are impacted by antibiotics, hormones, and diet

Audrey will guide you in using real food, probiotics, and balanced nutrition to reclaim your body’s inner harmony.

🤝 Together, Sandra and Audrey will reveal how everyday habits can turn harmless fungi into unwanted guests — and how mindful nutrition and natural remedies can help restore balance to your body, inside and out.

summary: A Ceremony of Remembrance, Release and Renewal. A blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain. Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra is honoured to share this powerful ceremony to the women of The Hague.
description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony — The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women of The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a lady shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creatresses of our deepest longings and destinies.

Through this ceremony, participants are gently guided to release pain and sorrow held within the womb, restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

- The ceremony lasts approximately 60-90 minutes
- Limited to 13 women for an intimate and nurturing circle
- Bring only yourself and your wish to heal your womb
- Come prepared to share openly and receive in sisterhood
- The event will flow organically, occasionally there's a bit of journaling involved
- (Optional) Wear something that makes you feel feminine or honours your divine femininity

This ceremony will be offered regularly at The Hague Natural Health Centre, inviting women to reconnect with their innate feminine power and the healing wisdom of the Earth.

🌸  In healing our own wombs...we contribute to healing the womb of the Great Mother Earth.

title: Constellation Workshop: The Energy of Your Business
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary: This workshop offers entrepreneurs, business owners and founders an opportunity to look beneath the surface of their business, by exploring the energetic and systemic forces that influence decision-making, leadership, and momentum, when something feels “off” or somehow doesn't flow.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

The Energy of Your Business

✨ A business is not just a structure or a plan — it is a living system with its own dynamics, movements, and needs. And just like people, businesses can lose balance, become stuck, or carry hidden tensions that affect growth.

This session invites you to step back from daily operations and observe your business from a fresh, systemic perspective.

This workshop is for you if:

🌀 You feel your business has hit a plateau and don’t fully understand why
🌀 You are navigating a transition — new market, new partner, new direction
🌀 You sense misalignment between your vision and what is unfolding in reality
🌀 You carry too much of the weight alone and want to understand the system behind it
🌀 You wish to reconnect with the original purpose and energy of your venture

In this circle, through Systemic Constellations we will explore the deeper architecture of your business: the roles, responsibilities, partnerships, past decisions, and untold expectations that quietly shape its direction. Through this lens, clarity begins to emerge — often revealing what strengthens the business and what silently drains its vitality.

During the workshop, we will:

💼 Map the energetic structure of your business
💼 Explore how leadership, vision, team dynamics, and resources interact
💼 Identify hidden loyalties, outdated structures, or unresolved tensions
💼 Observe where your business wants to grow — and what needs to shift for that to happen
💼 Create space for renewed focus, alignment, and forward movement

✅ What to expect:

title: Your Individual Constellation Session
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS

Personal Constellation Session

✨ Systemic Constellations are a powerful tool to reveal what lies beneath the surface — whether it’s in family relationships, work dynamics, health, or even creativity. By giving form to what usually remains hidden, new perspectives and solutions emerge.

This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night (at 17:30, 18:40, 20:00). You can book a slot at your convenience to work on your question with the therapist.

This technique will offer a safe space for a deep and focused exploration of your personal theme. The examples of questions can be:

🌀 Relationships — Why do I always end up in the same type of relationship? How can I rebuild trust after a breakup?

🌀 Career or business challenges — Should I stay in my current job or take the risk of starting something new? What blocks me from stepping into leadership with confidence?

🌀 Health and energy — Why do I feel so tired all the time? What can I do to support my body in healing and regaining strength?

🌀 Life direction & creativity — I feel stuck and don’t know what I want next. How can I move forward with my project, book, or dream that keeps stalling?

✅ The Power of Constellations:

Each individual constellation will be conducted one-on-one using a constellation board — a visual and symbolic tool that allows key elements of your question (Figures) to be placed and observed in relation to one another. As the pieces move and interact, inner dynamics, emotional tensions, and subconscious patterns begin to reveal themselves. The board makes visible what the mind cannot yet see — how energies, relationships, and internal parts influence your choices and state of being.

This session is diagnostic and exploratory in nature. The focus is not on immediate resolution, but on bringing hidden dynamics to the surface so they can be seen clearly. By shining light on what operates in the subconscious, you gain the awareness needed to take more conscious, empowered steps forward in your life.

This evening will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions, in-person and online. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections, supporting participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with greater clarity.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to join this special evening of exploration and discovery.

location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: A Ceremony honouring our ancestors, the present moment and sending blessings to the future.  Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra is honoured to share this powerful ceremony with the women of The Hague.
description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony, The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women of The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a lady shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creators of our deepest hopes and desires.

Through this ceremony, participants are gently guided to release pain and sorrow held within the womb, restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

- The ceremony lasts approximately 90-120 minutes
- Limited to 7 women for an intimate and nurturing circle
- Bring only yourself and your wish to heal your womb
- Come prepared to share openly and receive in sisterhood
- Some reflective journaling will be part of the ceremony
- The event will flow organically, occasionally the event goes to 3 hours
- (Optional) Wear something that makes you feel feminine or honours your divine femininity

This ceremony will be offered regularly at The Hague Natural Health Centre, inviting women to reconnect with their innate feminine power and the healing wisdom of the Earth.

🌸  In healing our own wombs...we contribute to healing the womb of the Great Mother Earth.

title: Constellation Workshop: Ancestral Lineage
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Patterns of love, sacrifice, strength, fear, and resilience often travel through generations, quietly influencing how we relate, work, receive. This Constellations Workshop is dedicated to exploring how inherited behaviours may still be active in your present life.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Ancestral Lineage

Why Ancestral Lineage?

Many people discover that recurring challenges are often rooted in family systems rather than

individual experience:

💫  Repeating relationship or life patterns without understanding their origin

💫 Carrying emotional weight, responsibility, or guilt that does not feel fully personal

💫 Feeling blocked in movement, success, intimacy, or self-expression

💫 Remaining unconsciously loyal to ancestors through struggle, limitation, or sacrifice

Systemic Constellations make these hidden dynamics visible — gently, through embodied

experience.

This unique method offers a window into the subconscious, by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with their authentic path forward. With this technique, Representatives step into roles that represent inner parts of the Questioner. Their responses act as reflections of the unseen dynamics within the Questioner’s subconscious mind.

✨ This workshop already has a Questioner. We are inviting participants to join as

Representatives.

What you will gain as a Representative

In Systemic Constellations, Representatives frequently experience deep personal insight, even

without bringing their own question. By stepping into the field, you may:

✅ Encounter themes that resonate strongly with your own life

✅ Gain clarity without verbal storytelling or exposure

✅ Experience emotional release or energetic realignment

✅ Strengthen your sense of belonging and inner grounding

The workshop is facilitated by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Systemic Constellations

therapist, who holds a grounded and attentive space for psychological and energetic

exploration.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your

openness and willingness to explore.

✨ If you feel a subtle pull to be part of this constellation field — as a Representative — you

are warmly invited.

Often, the constellation we step into is exactly the one our own system is ready to explore.

summary: An exploratory Constellations Workshop to uncover the hidden dynamics behind your health and vitality. We will look beyond symptoms into the deeper connections between body, mind, and family history, shining light on the areas that most need attention.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

My Health

We often take our health for granted — until our body reminds us otherwise.

Fatigue, recurring symptoms, or chronic conditions can all be signals that something deeper is asking for attention. In this exploratory Constellations Workshop, we will look beneath the surface of symptoms and listen to what your body may be trying to say:

❓Which unspoken loyalties, ancestral patterns or hidden family burdens can be showing up as illness or fatigue?

❓How do you unconsciously limit your own energy and resilience?

❓What would help your body feel safe enough to restore its natural balance?

🌿 The power of Constellations

This workshop is not about quick fixes. It is about bringing to light the patterns that quietly influence your body’s state of health and energy.

Systemic constellations reveal subconscious dynamics that often remain invisible: unresolved emotions, ancestral burdens, or loyalty to those who suffered before us.

During the workshop, we will:

🌀 Explore the connection between your inner world and your physical state

🌀 Map out where life energy becomes blocked or depleted

🌀 Observe how family dynamics and beliefs affect health and vitality

🌀 Open a pathway to greater awareness and balance

✅What to expect:

The Systemic Constellations technique involves role-playing and representation. Stand-ins will be asked to describe how they feel in relation to figures representing your connection with Health.The purpose is diagnostic, not instant healing — allowing you to see subconscious processes as if in a mirror. You will gain clarity about what is shaping your health today and what may need attention to restore your energy.

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in uncovering hidden dynamics, releasing inherited burdens, and reconnecting with their natural vitality.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ Come as you are, with curiosity and openness. We will hold a grounded and compassionate space where hidden dynamics can be seen — and your path to greater health can begin to unfold.

location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary: An introduction to colour and Emotionally Freedom Technique (EFT) tapping. Discover how the spiritual psychology of colour and EFT (tapping) work together to help you release old patterns that limit your health, wealth, relationships, confidence and overall wellbeing.
description:
Discover how the spiritual psychology of colour and EFT (tapping) work together to help you release old patterns that limit your health, wealth, relationships, confidence and overall wellbeing. This introductory evening offers simple yet powerful tools that support real change in a gentle and practical  way.

About the event

👉 What would you most like to change in your life?

👉 Your health, wealth, relationships or career?

Maybe you want to let go of the stress you carry, overcome a fear of public speaking or finally release hurt, pain (physical/emotional) or resentment that has stayed with you for years.  We all carry patterns that shape the way we behave and influence the choices we make. Many of these patterns come from childhood influences such as parents and teachers. Some are inherited through our family line. Beliefs such as I’m not good/pretty/clever enough, I don’t deserve it, or I can’t speak up because people won’t like me quietly affect everything from confidence to relationships to abundance. The life that we subconsciously create for ourselves is a mirror of the patterns and beliefs that we carry. Just imagine what your life could look like if you no longer took these beliefs as truth!

Colour 🌈

Colour analysis uses the spiritual psychology of colour to identify the deeper patterns that subconsciously guide and impact your life. The colour bottles used work directly with your energy field and bypass the conscious mind. Colour supports you in clearing blocks, releasing emotional weight and resistance so you can move forward with more clarity.

EFT (Emotional Freedom Technique) 🤏

EFT or tapping is a simple technique that uses the body’s meridian points, similar to acupressure. By tapping these points with your fingertips you activate the body’s natural ability to heal and restore balance to the body's system. Tapping allows you to take your physical wellbeing into your hands and helps reduce stress, anxiety, emotional tension and physical discomfort.

Colour + EFT Together

When colour and EFT are combined the effect is deeply supportive. They allow you to work on your wellbeing in a safe and empowering way. Colour highlights the pattern. Colour & EFT together then help unblock any resistance and clear those patterns. Together they bring awareness, release and a sense of renewed possibility. Once you understand your pattern you can choose to keep running it or let it go. You become the author of what comes next.

What to Expect

The session lasts approximately 90 minutes.  No experience needed. A welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. Gentle guidance and space to explore and let go of the patterns and beliefs that no longer (and maybe never did!) support you.

💫  What you free within you transforms the world around you. 💫

title: Jikiden Reiki Training - Level 2 Okuden
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Constinue your Reiki journey with Okuden - Level 2 Reiki training. Led by Reiki Shihan, Sandra Delgado Quist, this course is for those students who have already training in JIKIDEN REIKI only.
description:
### Deepen your Reiki Practice

Take your Reiki practice to the next level by learning more about the original teachings of Makao Usui Sensei. Jikiden means óriginal teaching', these practices have been passed down through various teachers but the Jikiden Reiki Institute aims to maintain the original teachings, keeping them simple and easy to implement. This Okuden (Level 2) training is designed for dedicated practitioners ready to expand their healing toolkit and deepen their connection to the original Japanese teachings of Usui Sensei.

## Level 2 Jikiden Reiki Training (Okuden)

This course is for those ready to build upon their foundational skills and gain a more profound understanding of the Gokai (principles) and techniques. Whether you are a dedicated self-healer or a professional therapist looking to enhance your practice, Level 2 provides powerful, practical tools for emotional and distance healing.

### What You Will Learn

- Distance Reiki (Enkaku): Learn specific techniques to send Reiki to your loved ones and clients without regard ttime or space.
- Psychological Healing (Sei He Ki): Implement methods for treating unwanted habits, emotional blocks, and psychological patterns into your practice.
- Case Studies: Discuss and analyze sample cases to refine your clinical approach.
- Energy Protection: Practical tips on how to maintain and protect your own energy field while treating others.
- Receive guidance on how to progress into your own professional practice or move toward a teaching path.

### Your Trainer: Sandra Quist

With 15 years of experience as a Jikiden Reiki Shihan, Sandra brings a wealth of grounded, practical wisdom to her courses. In addition to her Reiki practice, she is a professional homeopath and Shamanic practitioner. While Sandra is strictly dedicated to preserving the authentic, original Jikiden Reiki teachings during the formal lessons, she loves to share "bonus" insights from her diverse background during breaks—offering a unique, holistic perspective you won't find elsewhere.

### The Venue

Our training takes place in a serene "urban sanctuary" located in Scheveningen, just a short walk from the coastline.

- Weather permitting, we often take our meditations or specific teachings directly onto the beach to harness the natural elements.
- A peaceful, dedicated space designed for focus and rejuvenation
- An agenda for the training will be sent a week before the course since the flow typically depends on the number of participants.

### Requirements for Attendance

To ensure a high standard of practice and group cohesion, students must meet the following criteria:

1. Cost of the course is 450 euro - a deposit of 100 euro is due at registration with the balance due 1 week before the course
2. Prior Training: Must have completed Level 1 with a qualified Jikiden Reiki Shihan within the past 5 years.
3. Active Practice: Must be actively and regularly practicing Reiki (on yourself or others).
4. Must practice continued self care so that you remain grounded and able to hold space for others

Bonus:  For attendee's of this training, free admittance to the next 'Homeopathy for the Home' online workshop is included. This is a 2 hour introduction to using homeopathy and Schuessler Tissue Salts for first aid, minor complaints and natural energy boosts. It is one of Sandra's popular online courses and really supports people who want to take their health into their own hands using natural medicine.

We look forward to welcoming you  💖

description:
Befriending your Inner Trickster

How to Turn Your Inner Frenemies into Best Friends

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_077191c7c8d243a79b615b73bdb2e2b2~mv2.png)

So often, we are pulled in different directions by the many aspects that make up our identity. What if you could recognise, name and understand these inner forces, and learn how to work with them rather than against them? In this workshop, astrology is used as a guide for personal growth, offering a clear and practical way to explore your inner world. This is the Star Psychology approach: personal development counselling based on a clear inner roadmap.  You will leave with a deeper understanding of how to create greater inner harmony.

About the Event

Join us for your first introduction to the world of Star Psychology and its rich landscape of archetypes. This approach brings together nature and nurture in a playful, creative, and grounded exploration of personal development. Your guide on this journey is Lysanne Sizoo, Transpersonal Psychologist, who has over 25 years of experience supporting clients in reconnecting with their inner compass.

Drawing on the planetary wisdom of astrology, alongside a healthy dose of practical common sense, Lysanne will introduce you to your core inner archetypes. You’ll learn how to reconnect with your witnessing self, allowing you to work more skilfully with inner challenges and make the most of your unique talents.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/f33bc9_bb68e413bd4b4870997270cfb4e197de~mv2.jpg)

You’ll Learn About

👉 Your core archetype: its unique gifts and what may be holding you back

👉  How to use the witnessing self to bring harmony to your inner world

👉 Your personal decision-making strategy and life purpose

What You’ll Receive

🎁 A personal overview highlighting the main elements of your Star Psychology birth chart

💝 An MP3 recording of the guided meditation used during the workshop

When booking, please share your date of birth, time of birth (if possible), and place of birth.

Experience the Transformative Power of Sound Healing

👉 Limited to 8 people to ensure a comfortable and safe experience.

Sound healing is a therapeutic practice that uses vibrational frequencies from instruments like singing bowls, gongs, and chimes to restore harmony in the body and mind. These soothing sounds help reduce stress, promote deep relaxation, and support emotional and physical well-being by aligning your energy.

During a sound healing session, vibrations gently guide you into a meditative state, encouraging the release of tension and balancing your inner rhythms. Many people report feeling lighter, calmer, and more centered after just one session.

Curious to experience it yourself? Join our Sound Healing evening and let the calming frequencies wash over you. Whether you're seeking stress relief, better sleep, or simply a moment of peace, this is your opportunity to explore the benefits firsthand. Come relax, recharge, and discover the healing power of sound!

Led by Joël Van der Putten, of Divine Tuning. Joël's mission is to inspire people with a combination of sound, music and ritual work. He understands that by working through sound, directly on these levels, the healing power of the body is activated along with the higher consciousness.

description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony, The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women of The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a lady shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creators of our deepest hopes and desires.

Through this ceremony, participants are gently guided to release pain and sorrow held within the womb, restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

title: Your Individual Constellation Session
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS

Personal Constellation Session

✨ Systemic Constellations are a powerful tool to reveal what lies beneath the surface — whether it’s in family relationships, work dynamics, health, or even creativity. By giving form to what usually remains hidden, new perspectives and solutions emerge.

This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night (at 17:30, 18:40, 20:00). You can book a slot at your convenience to work on your question with the therapist.

This technique will offer a safe space for a deep and focused exploration of your personal theme. The examples of questions can be:

🌀 Relationships — Why do I always end up in the same type of relationship? How can I rebuild trust after a breakup?

🌀 Career or business challenges — Should I stay in my current job or take the risk of starting something new? What blocks me from stepping into leadership with confidence?

🌀 Health and energy — Why do I feel so tired all the time? What can I do to support my body in healing and regaining strength?

🌀 Life direction & creativity — I feel stuck and don’t know what I want next. How can I move forward with my project, book, or dream that keeps stalling?

✅ The Power of Constellations:

Each individual constellation will be conducted one-on-one using a constellation board — a visual and symbolic tool that allows key elements of your question (Figures) to be placed and observed in relation to one another. As the pieces move and interact, inner dynamics, emotional tensions, and subconscious patterns begin to reveal themselves. The board makes visible what the mind cannot yet see — how energies, relationships, and internal parts influence your choices and state of being.

This session is diagnostic and exploratory in nature. The focus is not on immediate resolution, but on bringing hidden dynamics to the surface so they can be seen clearly. By shining light on what operates in the subconscious, you gain the awareness needed to take more conscious, empowered steps forward in your life.

This evening will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions, in-person and online. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections, supporting participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with greater clarity.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to join this special evening of exploration and discovery.

title: Dying to Talk: A Supper Series
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Gather over a warm bowl of soup for mindful conversations on end-of-life preparation. Inspired by the "parent tree" metaphor, we’ll explore how our final wishes can nourish the community we leave behind. This 6-month series rotates through three core themes—join us for 1 or all 3 topics.
description:
Topic:  Death Awareness & the End-of-Life

Date:  March 30 & June 10

What if we became curious about creating our ending? In this mindful evening workshop, we’ll gather around the table over soup to contemplate the ways in which we can prepare for our death. Using mindfulness & meditation, an imagery exercise, and guided reflection, Amanda will lead the group through conscious conversation on what we might want and what we can expect in our end-of-life experience.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6c8b5fc1d52a4bad914d31305632dba4~mv2.jpg)

People who engage in contemplating the end of their lives often have less anxiety when the aging process begins. This workshop creates a supportive environment to explore the curiosity, fear, and possibilities of the end. We encourage active involvement through group sharing and will bring connection in the group, empowering you to:

- Engage your family and community in your preparation process
- Craft wishes for your end-of-life care
- Provide  preparatory exercises and contemplative tools to carry into your daily life

If you’ve hiked through a giant Redwood forest in California, you may find yourself in the middle of a fairy ring of majestic trees. When a Redwood tree is struck down by logging, lightning, or fire, a ring of young trees will grow around the trunk of the tree, drawing from the root system of the parent tree. As the parent tree breaks down, it returns to the soil, continuing to nourish the next generation of trees.

This discussion uses the metaphor of the "parent tree" to explore how to feed the younger trees by doing the steps that are necessary now in order to help create a fairy ring of trees that will help you at the end of your life, and live on to support this lineage beyond your death.

This evening is intended to nourish the soil of your life in order to nourish

the soil of life beyond you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

Amanda Coggin has led death awareness conversations for the last 15 years in Buddhist hospice work and as a hospital chaplain in San Francisco, California.  She is leading this series of talks discussing various aspects of the dying process with the aim of bringing awareness to this important topic that has been largely left unspoken in the past. We hope these discussions will support and prepare the community for the dying process.

Upcoming Topics for this Series:

April 20 & July 8

Dying + The Mindful Caregiver

May 11 & August 24

Grief as a Gateway to Hope

description:
This short online introduction offers a practical and inspiring look into vibrational or energy medicine, focusing on three modalities: homeopathy, flower essences, and tissue salts.

Designed for use in the home and for everyday wellbeing, this session focuses on simple first-aid and acute situations, rather than chronic conditions. You’ll learn how to support yourself and your family with natural remedies that are safe, non-toxic, and free of side effects, so you can begin using them immediately and confidently.

We’ll explore how these three forms of vibrational medicine work together to support the body, mind, and emotions:

💧 Homeopathy – works on a deep energetic level, stimulating the body’s own healing response. We’ll focus on homeopathic remedies especially useful for first-aid and common ailments such as injuries, sprains, fevers, teething, and shock.

🌿 Schuessler Tissue Salts – gentle mineral-based remedies that nourish and strengthen the physical body, helping to replenish essential minerals needed for energy, recovery, and resilience.

🌸 Flower Essences – subtle emotional balancers that help ease feelings of anxiety, worry, perfectionism, grief, and overthinking. They support inner calm, emotional stability, and clarity during times of stress or change.

Together, these natural modalities provide simple yet powerful tools to take charge of your own health and support your family’s wellbeing — physically, emotionally, and energetically.

Join us for an interactive and down-to-earth discussion on how to use these remedies safely and effectively, empowering you to bring gentle, natural healing into your everyday life.  Please note, that this is an introduction to using the remedies, they are safe for babies, animals and plants so you can feel confident in using them without harm. It is the aim that you begin using a few remedies to gain confidence in your own prescribing and intuition and ultimately able to support yourself and your family naturally.

This workshop is hosted by Sandra Quist, Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner. For more information, contact Sandra via sandra@thehague-naturalhealthcentre.com.

Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom

This is a new monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the last Tuesday of each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. Our aim is simple:

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. We’ll keep the evening grounded and nourishing by keeping the meal simple with a fresh bowl of soup and salad.

Your hosts for the evening will be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

title: Leela & Constellations Day Retreat
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: A full-day mini-retreat is an immersive experience bringing together two powerful transformational tools — the ancient game of Leela & Systemic Constellations. A carefully held space to work with your personal inquiry within a supportive and confidential group field of 6 participants.
description:
Leela & Constellations Day ✨

Are you feeling stuck in repetitive patterns, seeking a deeper understanding of your

life’s direction, or standing at a crossroads? We invite you to a deep Immersion into

your inner landscape. Together, the two powerful transformational tools — the ancient

game of Leela & Systemic Constellations – will help you uncover the hidden causes

and map out a new vector for your movement forward.

☸️ Leela: The Mirror of the Soul

Leela is a sacred game of consciousness, rooted in at least two millennia of ancient

India’s wisdom traditions. It unfolds through 72 states of life, reflecting the full spectrum of human experience: limitations, resources, lessons, blind spots, and possibilities.

As you move through the game with your personal intention, your inner journey is

mirrored with remarkable precision. Complex situations begin to untangle. The game

provides the answers that resonate with your true Self, helping you feel a clearer

sense of direction.

Leela is not about predicting the future. It is about illuminating your present.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_5575a54a240b4b0d8f6d6d67b86b0118~mv2.jpg)

Systemic Constellations: Revealing the Hidden

This profound experiential method offers a window into the subconscious. It combines the depth of psychology, the structure of system-thinking, and a practical approach. Through visual representations, by working with deep emotional and energetic connections in the Field, the hidden dynamics are brought to light.

Patterns of loyalty, unconscious entanglements, and internal conflicts that usually

operate beneath the surface of awareness can be observed directly. From this new

perspective, an inner shift becomes possible — and when the inner configuration

changes, external circumstances begin to reorganise as well.

✅ What to expect

This mini-retreat offers a supportive space to reconnect with your own inner guidance,

a day of deep insight and meaningful internal shifts. For this full immersion we

recommend the maximum of 6 participants.

In the morning, we journey through the symbolic “Map of Life” with Leela.

As you move across its 72 states of consciousness, your personal question unfolds in

a structured yet intuitive way.

In the afternoon, we move into Constellations, to work on the inquiries and patterns

that surfaced during the game.

One by one, the participants will bring their question, and the others will step into

representative roles, embodying elements of his/her subconscious. Through their responses, the subtle relational and energetic dynamics surrounding the Questioner’s situation become tangible and observable.

Together, these two modalities create a powerful arch. Leela offers perspective and orientation, a high-level overview of your path; Constellations bring depth, structural clarity and a deep-dive into the roots of your

challenges.

You leave with a grounded understanding of what needs to shift at its roots. Patterns become visible. Resources emerge. The broader architecture of your current life chapter and the next steps begins to take

shape. How the Day will unfold:

10:00 — Arrival & Welcome tea with healthy snacks

10:30–13:30 — Opening Circle & Immersion into Leela, the game of Self-Knowledge

13:30–14:30 — Lunch break

14:30–15:00 — Transition & settling into Constellations space

15:00–18:00 — Systemic Constellation work on the questions that arise during Leela

18:00–19:00 — Integration & closing circle

This workshop will be facilitated by:

Alina Volodina — transformational Leela game guide and practitioner of regressive

hypnotherapy. She is also trained in Universal Therapy (Talpis method), guiding clients

into deep subconscious processes and inner realignment.

Nadia Eliseeva – ICF-certified coach and psychologist, trained in Systemic

Constellations therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the

subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being.

Language: This event is bilingual, held in Russian and English. No prior experience

with Leela or Constellations is necessary—only your openness and willingness to

explore.

✨ We invite you to dedicate this day to yourself — and step into the circle of deep

exploration together.
