summary: This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS

Personal Constellation Session

✨ Systemic Constellations are a powerful tool to reveal what lies beneath the surface — whether it’s in family relationships, work dynamics, health, or even creativity. By giving form to what usually remains hidden, new perspectives and solutions emerge.

This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night (at 17:30, 18:40, 20:00). You can book a slot at your convenience to work on your question with the therapist.

This technique will offer a safe space for a deep and focused exploration of your personal theme. The examples of questions can be:

🌀 Relationships — Why do I always end up in the same type of relationship? How can I rebuild trust after a breakup?

🌀 Career or business challenges — Should I stay in my current job or take the risk of starting something new? What blocks me from stepping into leadership with confidence?

🌀 Health and energy — Why do I feel so tired all the time? What can I do to support my body in healing and regaining strength?

🌀 Life direction & creativity — I feel stuck and don’t know what I want next. How can I move forward with my project, book, or dream that keeps stalling?

✅ The Power of Constellations:

Each individual constellation will be conducted one-on-one using a constellation board — a visual and symbolic tool that allows key elements of your question (Figures) to be placed and observed in relation to one another. As the pieces move and interact, inner dynamics, emotional tensions, and subconscious patterns begin to reveal themselves. The board makes visible what the mind cannot yet see — how energies, relationships, and internal parts influence your choices and state of being.

This session is diagnostic and exploratory in nature. The focus is not on immediate resolution, but on bringing hidden dynamics to the surface so they can be seen clearly. By shining light on what operates in the subconscious, you gain the awareness needed to take more conscious, empowered steps forward in your life.

This evening will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions, in-person and online. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections, supporting participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with greater clarity.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to join this special evening of exploration and discovery.

title: Befriending Your Inner Tricksters
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary: In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll learn how to recognise, name, and work with the different aspects of your inner world, so they can start supporting you rather than holding you back.
description:
Introduction to Star Psychology ✨

We’ll gently introduce the foundations of astro-psychology, a unique approach that blends astrology, Human Design, and psychology. No prior knowledge is needed. Using your birth chart as a simple map of your inner world, you’ll begin to understand your patterns, strengths, challenges, and deeper motivations in a clear and accessible way.

This workshop offers a welcoming introduction to Star Psychology and its rich world of inner archetypes. Developed by Lysanne Sizoo, this approach combines both nature and nurture, bringing together practical insight and intuitive understanding in a way that feels grounded, creative, and easy to relate to.

What you’ll explore

During the workshop, you’ll be introduced to the foundations of your birth chart and how it can serve as a simple map of your inner landscape.

Participants will learn about:

• Your two core inner archetypes and what they mean for you

• How to understand and work with inner conflicts

• A simple way to make decisions that feel more aligned

• How to step into the role of the observer rather than getting lost in thoughts or emotions

You will also receive:

• A simple personal overview of your Star Psychology birth chart

• A recording of the guided meditation from the workshop 🧘

What to expect

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. Through a combination of explanation, reflection, and guided meditation, you’ll begin to recognise the patterns and inner dynamics that shape how you think, feel, and make decisions.

About your host

Lysanne Sizoo is a psychosynthesis psychotherapist and the founder of the Star Psychology method. For over twenty-five years, she has guided individuals through a holistic approach that connects psychology, astrology, and human design.

Important information

When booking, please share your date of birth, time of birth (if possible), and place of birth so your personal overview can be prepared.

To allow time for this preparation, registration closes three days before the event.

title: Dying to Talk:  The Mindful Caregiver
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: In the second of our series, Amanda explores the dance of mindful caregiving. Through poetry and meditation, we’ll discuss how mindfulness and self-compassion prevent burnout. Whether you're a family or professional caregiver, join us to find clarity and connection within the storm.✨
description:
Topic:  Dying & the Mindful Caregiver

Dates:  April 20 & July 8

In this second instalment of our mindful workshop series on death, we continue our exploration of end-of-life preparation and the path of the mindful caregiver.

True mindfulness and self-compassion are the two pillars of a stool that becomes complete only when contemplation meets action. This evening, Amanda will discuss the evolving roles of both the dying person and the family caregiver, exploring how these dynamics shift as illness and death progress. This workshop is equally valuable for professional caregivers or those aspiring to the field, offering a "dance" toward clarity, connection, and completion when everyone involved receives the support they need.

Through poetry, guided meditation, and open discussion, we will empower you to:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_4e27f16472b44ba187101db7835d0359~mv2.jpg)

- Integrate Mindfulness: Use daily awareness as a foundation for caregiving.
- Practice Self-Compassion: Build resilience within the caregiving environment.
- Navigate Palliative Care: Understand the nuances and benefits as care transitions toward hospice.
- Support the Spirit: Gain insight into the mental and spiritual needs of those at the end of life.

Join us to gather essential tools for your "caregiving toolbox," transforming a potentially depleting experience into one of hope and resilience.

“There are only four kinds of people in the world—those who have been caregivers, those who are currently caregivers, those who will be caregivers, and those who will need caregivers.” — Rosalynn Carter

“Let there be an opening into the quiet that lies beneath the chaos, where you can find the peace you did not think possible and see what shimmers within the storm.” — John O’Donohue

“Our intent isn’t to feel better, but to get better at feeling.” — Michael Brown

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

Amanda Coggin has led death awareness conversations for the last 15 years in Buddhist hospice work and as a hospital chaplain in San Francisco, California.  She is leading this series of talks discussing various aspects of the dying process with the aim of bringing awareness to this important topic that has been largely left unspoken in the past. We hope these discussions will support and prepare the community for the dying process.

Other topics for this Series:

Death Awareness & End of Life

March 30 & June 10

Grief as a Gateway to Hope

May 11 & August 24

summary: Gather over a warm bowl of soup for mindful conversations on end-of-life preparation. Inspired by the "parent tree" metaphor, we’ll explore how our final wishes can nourish the community we leave behind. This 6-month series rotates through three core themes—join us for 1 or all 3 topics.
description:
Topic:  Dying + The Mindful Caregiver

What if we became curious about creating our ending? In this mindful evening workshop, we’ll gather around the table over soup to contemplate the ways in which we can prepare for our death. Using mindfulness & meditation, an imagery exercise, and guided reflection, Amanda will lead the group through conscious conversation on what we might want and what we can expect in our end-of-life experience.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6c8b5fc1d52a4bad914d31305632dba4~mv2.jpg)

People who engage in contemplating the end of their lives often have less anxiety when the aging process begins. This workshop creates a supportive environment to explore the curiosity, fear, and possibilities of the end. We encourage active involvement through group sharing and will bring connection in the group, empowering you to:

- Engage your family and community in your preparation process
- Craft wishes for your end-of-life care
- Provide  preparatory exercises and contemplative tools to carry into your daily life

If you’ve hiked through a giant Redwood forest in California, you may find yourself in the middle of a fairy ring of majestic trees. When a Redwood tree is struck down by logging, lightning, or fire, a ring of young trees will grow around the trunk of the tree, drawing from the root system of the parent tree. As the parent tree breaks down, it returns to the soil, continuing to nourish the next generation of trees.

This discussion uses the metaphor of the "parent tree" to explore how to feed the younger trees by doing the steps that are necessary now in order to help create a fairy ring of trees that will help you at the end of your life, and live on to support this lineage beyond your death.

This evening is intended to nourish the soil of your life in order to nourish  the soil of life beyond you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

description:
## About the Evening

Join us for a relaxed and nourishing Reiki Exchange Day at The Hague Natural Health Centre.This gathering is open to all Reiki practitioners from any lineage or level. Whether you are looking to sharpen your skills, reconnect with your practice, or simply enjoy receiving Reiki from fellow practitioners, this evening is designed to support your growth and  wellbeing.

The purpose of this exchange is simple.We learn from each other. We ask questions. We share what works in our own practices. And most importantly, we give and receive Reiki in a balanced and respectful way.

These exchanges will begin every other month, and we hope they will grow into a steady community tradition.

Please arrive ready to both give and receive Reiki. The length of the session will obviously depend on the number of participants so please plan to be flexible. If you prefer only to receive and cannot give, we kindly suggest booking an individual session instead, so that the group experience stays fair for everyone. 🤍

We welcome all energy practitioners to join us in community.

## ✨ What Participants Experience

- An energy treatment from fellow practitioners
- Space to ask questions and share experiences
- A chance to maintain and deepen personal practice
- Connection with like-minded practitioners
- Collective learning, because everyone brings unique insights
- Mini treatment rounds: usually one person receives 20 minutes from 2–3 practitioners

🌱 Come as you are, and leave a little more connected, a quiet evening of shared healing can shift more than you think!

title: Soul Suppers - Sharing wisdom & a meal
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Soul Suppers is a monthly gathering for professional practitioners in the healing, psychological, medical, and therapeutic fields to share wisdom, support one another, and engage in meaningful conversation.
description:
Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom

Note:  The meal consists of a vegetarian soup, salad and light bites. We do our best to accommodate the various dietary restrictions by keeping it simple and light.

This is a monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the last Tuesday of each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. As those who hold space for others, we also need a place to be held, witnessed, and supported.

Each month, we will explore a topic chosen to spark insight into both our personal and professional lives. To begin, we will focus on themes such as Identity (Jan), Relationships (Feb), Boundaries (Mar), Barriers to Care (Apr), and Gender (May). These topics will likely change, allowing the circle to evolve organically with the needs and interests of the attendees.

Our aim is simple:

👉 Learn from one another

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. The conversations tend to go deep and leave attendee's with food for thought long after the evening is over - please know that it is a safe space where conversations should remain only within that space.

Your hosts for the evening will be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

summary: In this practical 3-day workshop, you’ll learn how to use your breath to unlock more energy, calm your mind, and release stress—so you can feel more balanced, focused, and in control of your emotions.
description:
The Art of Breathing ✨

The “Art of Breathing” is a structured 3-day workshop where participants learn breathing techniques and meditation practices designed to improve mental and physical well-being. The core practice taught is Sudarshan Kriya (SKY), a rhythmic breathing technique.

Through guided practice, participants explore how conscious breathing can help manage stress and anxiety, enhance immunity and overall well-being, and support deeper, restorative rest. The workshop introduces breathwork and meditation practices that help cultivate inner peace and emotional balance.

What you’ll explore

During the workshop, you’ll learn how different breathing techniques can influence your energy, emotions, and mental clarity.

Participants will learn about:

• Three powerful breathing techniques that can be applied regularly to manage stress

• Practices that support deep relaxation and inner calm

• Simple ways to unlock more joy and peace in everyday life

What to expect

In this experiential workshop, you’ll be guided through breathing techniques and meditation practices that help calm the mind, restore energy, and support emotional balance.

About the host

Akshita Chordia is a certified breathwork and meditation trainer with Art of Living International. With over five years of experience, she teaches simple and practical techniques that support mental clarity, balance, and overall well-being.

Karin Holley is a PCC-certified leadership coach, counsellor, and trainer who supports professionals in finding greater calm, clarity, and confidence in their work and personal lives. Her approach combines deep listening with leadership and somatic practices.

Important information

This is a 3-day event taking place on Friday May 1 (18:30–21:30), Saturday May 2 (09:00–12:00), and Sunday May 3 (09:00–12:00).

No prior meditation or breathwork experience is needed.

Participants are invited to bring a yoga mat, blanket, yoga cushion or bolster, water bottle, notebook and pen, and to wear comfortable clothing suitable for breathing and relaxation practices.

To allow time for preparation, registration closes three days before the event.

title: Dying to Talk:  Grief as a gateway to Hope
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: In this evenings topic, Amanda explores the terrain of grief as a garden to be tended. From diagnosis to loss, we’ll discuss the six needs of grief and use creative rituals to bridge pain toward hope. Join us over summer soup to learn how the heart mends and grows through grieving. 🌿
description:
Topic:  Grief as a gateway to Hope

This session is being offered on  May 11 & August 24

Note: People are welcome to any of the 3 topics and are not required to attend all 3 topics.

This third topic in our death awareness series, we venture into the terrain of grief and explore what arises when we purposefully process loss in our day-to-day lives.

Grief often begins long before a loved one passes, taking us on an unanticipated physical and existential journey. If we tend to our grief like a garden, it reveals its potential for growth. It may arrive timidly upon a diagnosis, hurriedly as an end nears, or suddenly with unexpected loss. Most importantly, grief forces us to pay attention by slowing... us... down.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_de1f6eb5422846788026f5025627d953~mv2.jpg)

Together, we will explore the different dimensions of loss—relational, functional, material, and the shifting of roles. We will discuss the "six needs of grief," understand grief as a reservoir, and find ourselves held within the intimacy of a safe, supportive container. We will also introduce creative rituals as "helpers", tools designed to bridge the gap between grief and a sense of healing and hope.

Over a bowl of fresh summer soup, Amanda will facilitate a deeper understanding of the subtle needs of grief. We will explore how being present in the body and in nature can support us, showing us how the heart can grow even in the midst of pain. Here, we learn that suffering can be a wise companion, helping us tend to and mend the holes left in our hearts.

“Go into your grief, for there your soul will grow.” - Carl Jung

“Grief is life turning toward itself,” Trauma Stewardship by Laura van Dernoot Lipsky

“If you live deeper in the Heart, the mirror gets clearer and clearer.” - Rumi

Participants should be at least six months past a significant grief experience, or receiving individual support before the workshop. This helps ensure everyone is appropriately supported during the event.

title: Your Individual Constellation Session
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS

Personal Constellation Session

✨ Systemic Constellations are a powerful tool to reveal what lies beneath the surface — whether it’s in family relationships, work dynamics, health, or even creativity. By giving form to what usually remains hidden, new perspectives and solutions emerge.

This evening is designed for those who are ready to go deeper — to explore real-life questions with focus and depth, uncovering the subconscious dynamics behind them. We’ll run three one-on-one, 60-minute sessions in a single night (at 17:30, 18:40, 20:00). You can book a slot at your convenience to work on your question with the therapist.

This technique will offer a safe space for a deep and focused exploration of your personal theme. The examples of questions can be:

🌀 Relationships — Why do I always end up in the same type of relationship? How can I rebuild trust after a breakup?

🌀 Career or business challenges — Should I stay in my current job or take the risk of starting something new? What blocks me from stepping into leadership with confidence?

🌀 Health and energy — Why do I feel so tired all the time? What can I do to support my body in healing and regaining strength?

🌀 Life direction & creativity — I feel stuck and don’t know what I want next. How can I move forward with my project, book, or dream that keeps stalling?

✅ The Power of Constellations:

Each individual constellation will be conducted one-on-one using a constellation board — a visual and symbolic tool that allows key elements of your question (Figures) to be placed and observed in relation to one another. As the pieces move and interact, inner dynamics, emotional tensions, and subconscious patterns begin to reveal themselves. The board makes visible what the mind cannot yet see — how energies, relationships, and internal parts influence your choices and state of being.

This session is diagnostic and exploratory in nature. The focus is not on immediate resolution, but on bringing hidden dynamics to the surface so they can be seen clearly. By shining light on what operates in the subconscious, you gain the awareness needed to take more conscious, empowered steps forward in your life.

This evening will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions, in-person and online. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections, supporting participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and aligning with greater clarity.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to join this special evening of exploration and discovery.

title: The Rite of the Womb & Yin Body Journey
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Join us for a sacred four-hour journey of cacao, Yin bodywork, and the Rite of the Womb. This intimate circle invites women and daughters to release stored fear and reclaim the womb as a centre of joy. Together, we honour our divine femininity and strengthen the sacred bonds of sisterhood.
description:
### The Rite of the Womb & Yin Body Journey 🌿

A Sacred Mother-Daughter & Sisterhood Circle

Join us for a transformative 4-hour journey of healing, soft cacao, and deep remembrance. This special collaboration brings together two powerful modalities to help women and the next generation of young women to reconnect with their innate feminine power.

Soft Cacao & Yin Body Work

Willemijn will begin by guiding you gently into a descent of "Yin" energy. Through soft cacao, breathwork, and body-oriented exercises, you will be guided to unwind the pelvis and hips. This portion includes a Trance Journey, a gentle form of hypnosis which encourages deep relaxation and a subconscious "cleansing" of the womb space. It is a time to feel safe in your body and surrender to your natural softness. We recommend wearing loose comfortable clothing so that you can move without restrictions.

The Rite of the Womb

Following your inner journey, Sandra Quist will share the 13th Rite of the Munay-Ki. This lineage blessing from the Amazon reminds us: The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. Through this transmission, we gently release stored sorrow, restoring the womb as a center of joy and vitality. We will take time to acknowledge our ancestral lineage, be grateful for the present and send blessings into the future.

Mothers, Daughters & Sisters

This edition is extra special as we recognize the bond between mothers and daughters. We invite young girls stepping into womanhood to sit in circle with us, fostering an empowered relationship with their bodies from the start. Women are equally welcome to attend solo; we all sit as sisters in this sacred lineage.

What to Expect:

- Duration: Approximately 4 hours.
- Intimacy: Limited to 13 participants for a nurturing environment.
- Preparation: Bring a journal and wear something that honors your divine femininity.
- Impact: A collective healing that ripples out to the Great Mother Earth.

### Is my daughter ready? A Guide for Mothers

Bringing a daughter into a healing circle is a beautiful way to break the chain of inherited silence or shame. Here is how to know if this ceremony is a good fit:

1. Age & Transition: We generally recommend this for girls aged 12 and up, particularly those who have started their menstrual cycle or are showing signs of moving into puberty.
2. Emotional Maturity: The ceremony involves about 4 hours of focus, including quiet meditation and reflective journaling. If she can sit comfortably in a calm environment for this duration, she is ready.
3. The Choice: To ensure she feels "safe in her body," the choice to attend should be hers. We suggest describing it as a "special celebration of becoming a young woman and learning how to listen to her body's wisdom."
4. Sisterhood Bond: This is a wonderful opportunity to encourage healthy emotional expression. Sharing this space helps her see that her "magic" resides within her, and she can feel connected to a community of women supporting her growth.

Meet Your Hosts

Willemijn van Duinen

Deeply connected to the Earth and the art of "inner alchemy," Willemijn specialises in transforming pain into gold by guiding people out of the mind and back into the body. As a mother and bodyworker, she uses intentional touch and Yin energy to help others soften their protective layers and return to their true origin. Her work, spanning 1-1 healing to Natural Horsemanship, is dedicated to bringing softness and Aliveness back into the world.

Sandra Delgado Quist

Sandra is a homeopath and shamanic energy medicine woman recently initiated into the sacred Munay-Ki Rites. Part of her mission is to weave ritual and ceremony back into modern life, creating space for us to remember the gift of being alive. Through her practice, she honors "Pachamama" (Mother Earth) and invites others to reconnect with the abundant healing wisdom of the natural world.

### Our Shared Philosophy

We believe that healing the feminine lineage requires both the softness of the body and the power of ancient ritual. By combining Willemijn’s somatic Yin journey with Sandra’s shamanic transmissions, we create a bridge between the physical and the spiritual—allowing mothers, daughters, and sisters to return home to their innate radiance together.

title: Sound Healing Experience
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Discover sound healing, a practice using vibrational frequencies from singing bowls and gongs to promote relaxation and balance. Enjoy a live demo by a local sound healer, immersing in soothing sounds that reduce stress, restore energy, and enhance well-being in a deeply calming experience.
description:
Experience the Transformative Power of Sound Healing

👉 Limited to 8 people to ensure a comfortable and safe experience.

Sound healing is a therapeutic practice that uses vibrational frequencies from instruments like singing bowls, gongs, and chimes to restore harmony in the body and mind. These soothing sounds help reduce stress, promote deep relaxation, and support emotional and physical well-being by aligning your energy.

During a sound healing session, vibrations gently guide you into a meditative state, encouraging the release of tension and balancing your inner rhythms. Many people report feeling lighter, calmer, and more centered after just one session.

Curious to experience it yourself? Join our Sound Healing evening and let the calming frequencies wash over you. Whether you're seeking stress relief, better sleep, or simply a moment of peace, this is your opportunity to explore the benefits firsthand. Come relax, recharge, and discover the healing power of sound!

Led by Joël Van der Putten, of Divine Tuning. Joël's mission is to inspire people with a combination of sound, music and ritual work. He understands that by working through sound, directly on these levels, the healing power of the body is activated along with the higher consciousness.

title: Soul Suppers - Sharing wisdom & a meal
location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Soul Suppers is a monthly gathering for professional practitioners in the healing, psychological, medical, and therapeutic fields to share wisdom, support one another, and engage in meaningful conversation.
description:
Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom

Note:  The meal consists of a vegetarian soup, salad and light bites. We do our best to accommodate the various dietary restrictions by keeping it simple and light.

This is a monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the Tuesday or Wednesday each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. As those who hold space for others, we also need a place to be held, witnessed, and supported.

Each month, we will explore a topic chosen to spark insight into both our personal and professional lives. To begin, we will focus on themes such as Gender (May), Growth (June), Energy (July). These topics will likely change, allowing the circle to evolve organically with the needs and interests of the attendees, if you have a topic you'd like to discuss, pease send us a message.

Our aim is simple:

👉 Learn from one another

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

👉 Support each other

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. The conversations tend to go deep and leave attendee's with food for thought long after the evening is over - please know that it is a safe space where conversations should remain only within that space.

Your hosts for the evening will be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

title: Befriending Your Inner Tricksters
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: See other events
summary: In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll learn how to recognise, name, and work with the different aspects of your inner world, so they can start supporting you rather than holding you back.
description:
Introduction to Star Psychology ✨

We’ll gently introduce the foundations of astro-psychology, a unique approach that blends astrology, Human Design, and psychology. No prior knowledge is needed. Using your birth chart as a simple map of your inner world, you’ll begin to understand your patterns, strengths, challenges, and deeper motivations in a clear and accessible way.

This workshop offers a welcoming introduction to Star Psychology and its rich world of inner archetypes. Developed by Lysanne Sizoo, this approach combines both nature and nurture, bringing together practical insight and intuitive understanding in a way that feels grounded, creative, and easy to relate to.

What you’ll explore

During the workshop, you’ll be introduced to the foundations of your birth chart and how it can serve as a simple map of your inner landscape.

Participants will learn about:

• Your two core inner archetypes and what they mean for you

• How to understand and work with inner conflicts

• A simple way to make decisions that feel more aligned

• How to step into the role of the observer rather than getting lost in thoughts or emotions

You will also receive:

• A simple personal overview of your Star Psychology birth chart

• A recording of the guided meditation from the workshop 🧘

What to expect

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. Through a combination of explanation, reflection, and guided meditation, you’ll begin to recognise the patterns and inner dynamics that shape how you think, feel, and make decisions.

About your host

Lysanne Sizoo is a psychosynthesis psychotherapist and the founder of the Star Psychology method. For over twenty-five years, she has guided individuals through a holistic approach that connects psychology, astrology, and human design.

Important information

When booking, please share your date of birth, time of birth (if possible), and place of birth so your personal overview can be prepared.

To allow time for this preparation, registration closes three days before the event.

title: Reiki Recharge & Exchange
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: A warm and welcoming Reiki exchange evening for practitioners from all lineages who wish to deepen their experience, learn from one another, and both give and receive treatment in a supportive community space. These exchanges are intended to become a regular rhythm at the centre.
description:
## About the Evening

Join us for a relaxed and nourishing Reiki Exchange Day at The Hague Natural Health Centre.This gathering is open to all Reiki practitioners from any lineage or level. Whether you are looking to sharpen your skills, reconnect with your practice, or simply enjoy receiving Reiki from fellow practitioners, this evening is designed to support your growth and  wellbeing.

The purpose of this exchange is simple.We learn from each other. We ask questions. We share what works in our own practices. And most importantly, we give and receive Reiki in a balanced and respectful way.

These exchanges will begin every other month, and we hope they will grow into a steady community tradition.

Please arrive ready to both give and receive Reiki. The length of the session will obviously depend on the number of participants so please plan to be flexible. If you prefer only to receive and cannot give, we kindly suggest booking an individual session instead, so that the group experience stays fair for everyone. 🤍

We welcome all energy practitioners to join us in community.

## ✨ What Participants Experience

- An energy treatment from fellow practitioners
- Space to ask questions and share experiences
- A chance to maintain and deepen personal practice
- Connection with like-minded practitioners
- Collective learning, because everyone brings unique insights
- Mini treatment rounds: usually one person receives 20 minutes from 2–3 practitioners

🌱 Come as you are, and leave a little more connected, a quiet evening of shared healing can shift more than you think!

title: The Art of Simple Fermentation
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Join us for a hands-on workshop exploring the art of simple fermentation. Learn to create your own nourishing, gut-friendly foods and discover how to bring them into your everyday meals.
description:
### The Art of Simple Fermentation 🌿

A Hands-On Workshop for Beginners

Fermented foods can support digestion, strengthen immunity, and bring more balance to your overall wellbeing. In this hands-on workshop, you’ll be guided through the essentials of fermentation in a simple and practical way—preparing your own ferments to take home while learning how to incorporate these living foods into your everyday meals.

With step-by-step guidance, you will prepare a selection of simple ferments and gain a clear understanding of the process behind them. The session also includes a light, wholesome lunch featuring fermented ingredients, offering a taste of how easily these foods can become part of your daily routine.

Held in a small group, this workshop offers a relaxed environment with space to learn, ask questions, and build confidence as you go.

What to Expect:

- Duration: Approximately 2.5 hours
- Group Size: Limited to 7 participants for a personal and hands-on experience
- Includes: All materials, glass jars, and a light lunch
- Preparation: You may bring a notebook and an apron
- Impact: Practical skills to confidently create your own nourishing, gut-friendly foods at home
- Investment: €65

Is this workshop for me?

This workshop is ideal for anyone who wants to start fermenting at home in a simple and accessible way.

- No experience required
- Suitable for beginners
- Perfect if you enjoy cooking, nutrition, or natural approaches to wellbeing

Please note that a minimum of 4 people is required for the event to proceed.

#### Meet Your Host

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_b03253cbb7564505a9357e3165483fe4~mv2.png)

Audrey Dickinson is a nutrition practitioner passionate about helping people reconnect with simple, nourishing food. Her approach focuses on making healthy eating practical, enjoyable, and sustainable in everyday life.

title: Dying to Talk: A Supper Series
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Gather over a warm bowl of soup for mindful conversations on end-of-life preparation. Inspired by the "parent tree" metaphor, we’ll explore how our final wishes can nourish the community we leave behind. This 6-month series rotates through three core themes—join us for 1 or all 3 topics.
description:
Topic:  Grief as a Gateway to Hope

What if we became curious about creating our ending? In this mindful evening workshop, we’ll gather around the table over soup to contemplate the ways in which we can prepare for our death. Using mindfulness & meditation, an imagery exercise, and guided reflection, Amanda will lead the group through conscious conversation on what we might want and what we can expect in our end-of-life experience.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6c8b5fc1d52a4bad914d31305632dba4~mv2.jpg)

People who engage in contemplating the end of their lives often have less anxiety when the aging process begins. This workshop creates a supportive environment to explore the curiosity, fear, and possibilities of the end. We encourage active involvement through group sharing and will bring connection in the group, empowering you to:

- Engage your family and community in your preparation process
- Craft wishes for your end-of-life care
- Provide  preparatory exercises and contemplative tools to carry into your daily life

If you’ve hiked through a giant Redwood forest in California, you may find yourself in the middle of a fairy ring of majestic trees. When a Redwood tree is struck down by logging, lightning, or fire, a ring of young trees will grow around the trunk of the tree, drawing from the root system of the parent tree. As the parent tree breaks down, it returns to the soil, continuing to nourish the next generation of trees.

This discussion uses the metaphor of the "parent tree" to explore how to feed the younger trees by doing the steps that are necessary now in order to help create a fairy ring of trees that will help you at the end of your life, and live on to support this lineage beyond your death.

This evening is intended to nourish the soil of your life in order to nourish the soil of life beyond you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

Amanda Coggin has led death awareness conversations for the last 15 years in Buddhist hospice work and as a hospital chaplain in San Francisco, California.  She is leading this series of talks discussing various aspects of the dying process with the aim of bringing awareness to this important topic that has been largely left unspoken in the past. We hope these discussions will support and prepare the community for the dying process.

### Meditation & Sharing Circle: Exploring Self-Compassion 🌿

A Gentle Space for Meditation, Reflection & Connection

Join us for a calming 2.5-hour gathering exploring self-compassion through guided meditation, journalling, and shared reflection. This intimate circle invites you to slow down, connect with your inner world, and explore how kindness towards yourself can support emotional wellbeing.

The session includes a 30-minute guided meditation to connect with deep peace and your body’s wisdom, followed by a facilitated sharing circle around compassion, self-kindness, and the moments when these may feel difficult to access.

Held in a small group, this event offers a calm and supportive environment with space to reflect, listen, and connect at your own pace.

What to Expect:

• Duration:Approximately 2.5 hours

• Includes:Tea, plant-based snacks, and blankets

• Preparation:Wear comfortable clothing and bring a yoga mat. You may also bring a journal and pen

• Impact:Space to cultivate more peace, self-awareness, and compassion in everyday life

Is this event for me?

This event is ideal for adults who want to create more peace and quiet in their inner world and cultivate more self-kindness.

title: Constellation Workshop:  Relationships
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Romantic partnerships, family, friendships, colleagues: every relationship has an outer dynamic and hidden emotional layers. Attraction, tension, closeness are often driven by subconscious influences and inherited family imprints. This event helps reveal the unseen forces shaping your relationships.
description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Relationships

🤔 Why do certain dynamics repeat, even with different people?

🤔Why does closeness sometimes trigger withdrawal?

🤔Why does conflict escalate beyond the present situation?

Many relational tensions are systemic in nature. Early attachment experiences, family beliefs about love and loyalty, unresolved past bonds, and unconscious identifications within the family system can all shape how we connect today.

This workshop is for you if:

🌀You notice repeating patterns in romantic or close relationships

🌀You struggle with boundaries — either too rigid or too diffuse

🌀You feel over-responsible for others’ emotions

🌀You experience jealousy, fear of abandonment, or difficulty trusting

🌀You are navigating a breakup, reconciliation, or complex family dynamic

Through Systemic Constellations, we explore the relational field around you. Other participants (Representatives) step into roles that reflect elements of the your relational system (Questioner). Their embodied responses reveal implicit dynamics, hidden loyalties, entanglements with former partners, or inherited models of partnership you may carry. When these dynamics are acknowledged, new movement becomes possible.

The process offers diagnostic insight — a way of looking into a mirror that shows what lies beneath the surface, often opening space for clarity and direction. We work on a first-registered basis and will hold as many constellations as time allows, understanding that not everyone may have the opportunity to bring their personal inquiry into the centre of the circle as Questioner.

During the workshop, we will:

💫Map the relational system influencing your current situation

💫Identify unconscious bonds that may interfere with present connection

💫Clarify where responsibility truly belongs

💫Restore balance between giving and receiving

The workshop is facilitated by Nadia Eliseeva, ICF-certified coach with background inpsychology, trained in Systemic Constellations therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being. She regularly holds Constellations Workshops, creating a structured, respectful, and confidential environment for deep exploration.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to enter a space where relationship patterns become visible — and connection can shift from reaction to conscious choice.

### The Art of Simple Fermentation 🌿

A Hands-On Workshop for Beginners

Fermented foods can support digestion, strengthen immunity, and bring more balance to your overall wellbeing. In this hands-on workshop, you’ll be guided through the essentials of fermentation in a simple and practical way—preparing your own ferments to take home while learning how to incorporate these living foods into your everyday meals.

With step-by-step guidance, you will prepare a selection of simple ferments and gain a clear understanding of the process behind them. The session also includes a light, wholesome lunch featuring fermented ingredients, offering a taste of how easily these foods can become part of your daily routine.

Held in a small group, this workshop offers a relaxed environment with space to learn, ask questions, and build confidence as you go.

What to Expect:

- Group Size: Limited to 7 participants for a personal and hands-on experience
- Includes: All materials, glass jars, and a light lunch
- Preparation: You may bring a notebook and an apron
- Impact: Practical skills to confidently create your own nourishing, gut-friendly foods at home
- Investment: €65

Is this workshop for me?

This workshop is ideal for anyone who wants to start fermenting at home in a simple and accessible way.

- No experience required
- Suitable for beginners
- Perfect if you enjoy cooking, nutrition, or natural approaches to wellbeing

Please note that a minimum of 4 people is required for the event to proceed.

Audrey Dickinson is a nutrition practitioner passionate about helping people reconnect with simple, nourishing food. Her approach focuses on making healthy eating practical, enjoyable, and sustainable in everyday life.

description:
#### The Territory of Money – Transformational Game 💰

A transformational psychological game is a guided self-discovery experience that combines coaching, psychology, reflection, and symbolic interaction.

Rather than focusing on competition, it helps participants uncover subconscious patterns, limiting beliefs, emotional triggers, and hidden behaviours that influence everyday decisions.

Through questions, symbols, and guided reflection, participants gain fresh insights, greater self-awareness, and a deeper understanding of what may be holding them back, from emotional blocks and family dynamics to long-standing survival patterns.

The Territory of Money

It is a deep psychological journey designed to help you explore the hidden dynamics behind income, financial growth, overspending, or fear of instability – in an interactive and experiential way.

Through the game process, participants begin to recognise the internal patterns influencing their financial decisions, energy level, and capacity to receive and hold money.

What to Expect:

- Duration: Approximately 4 hours
- Group Size: Limited to 2–8 participants for a personal experience
- Includes: Tea and healthy snacks
- Language: English
- Impact: Greater awareness and clarity around your relationship with money
- Investment: €37.50

Is this event for me?

This workshop is ideal for adults who would like to better understand their relationship with money and develop a healthier financial mindset.

- Expand your capacity to earn, receive, and manage money
- Develop a healthier and more supportive relationship with finances
- Identify limiting beliefs and emotional blocks around money
- Replace unhelpful financial patterns with empowering ones
- Approach money with greater ease, trust, and confidence
- Recognise new opportunities for financial growth and abundance

Please note that a minimum of 3 people is required for the event to proceed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

Meet Your Host

Nadia Eliseeva is an ICF-certified coach with a background in psychology and training in Systemic Constellations Therapy and Psychosomatics. Her work focuses on uncovering the subconscious dynamics that influence both emotional and physical wellbeing.

Through transformational games, constellation workshops, and individual sessions, Nadia creates a safe and confidential space for deep self-exploration, helping participants gain clarity, awareness, and meaningful personal insights.

summary: In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll learn how to recognise, name, and work with the different aspects of your inner world, so they can start supporting you rather than holding you back.
description:
Introduction to Star Psychology ✨

We’ll gently introduce the foundations of astro-psychology, a unique approach that blends astrology, Human Design, and psychology. No prior knowledge is needed. Using your birth chart as a simple map of your inner world, you’ll begin to understand your patterns, strengths, challenges, and deeper motivations in a clear and accessible way.

This workshop offers a welcoming introduction to Star Psychology and its rich world of inner archetypes. Developed by Lysanne Sizoo, this approach combines both nature and nurture, bringing together practical insight and intuitive understanding in a way that feels grounded, creative, and easy to relate to.

What you’ll explore

During the workshop, you’ll be introduced to the foundations of your birth chart and how it can serve as a simple map of your inner landscape.

Participants will learn about:

• Your two core inner archetypes and what they mean for you

• How to understand and work with inner conflicts

• A simple way to make decisions that feel more aligned

• How to step into the role of the observer rather than getting lost in thoughts or emotions

You will also receive:

• A simple personal overview of your Star Psychology birth chart

• A recording of the guided meditation from the workshop 🧘

What to expect

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. Through a combination of explanation, reflection, and guided meditation, you’ll begin to recognise the patterns and inner dynamics that shape how you think, feel, and make decisions.

About your host

Lysanne Sizoo is a psychosynthesis psychotherapist and the founder of the Star Psychology method. For over twenty-five years, she has guided individuals through a holistic approach that connects psychology, astrology, and human design.

Important information

When booking, please share your date of birth, time of birth (if possible), and place of birth so your personal overview can be prepared.

To allow time for this preparation, registration closes three days before the event.

location: Den Haag, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary: Soul Suppers is a monthly gathering for professional practitioners in the healing, psychological, medical, and therapeutic fields to share wisdom, support one another, and engage in meaningful conversation.
description:
Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom
June topic: Growth.

Note:  The meal consists of a vegetarian soup, salad and light bites. We do our best to accommodate the various dietary restrictions by keeping it simple and light.

This is a monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the Tuesday or Wednesday each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. As those who hold space for others, we also need a place to be held, witnessed, and supported.

Each month, we will explore a topic chosen to spark insight into both our personal and professional lives.  In July and August the monthly meet ups will be canceled due to the summer holidays and will resume again in September.  These topics will likely change, allowing the circle to evolve organically with the needs and interests of the attendees, if you have a topic you'd like to discuss, pease send us a message.

Our aim is simple:

👉 Learn from one another

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

👉 Support each other

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. The conversations tend to go deep and leave attendee's with food for thought long after the evening is over - please know that it is a safe space where conversations should remain only within that space.

Your hosts for the evening will be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

description:
Experience the Transformative Power of Sound Healing

👉 Limited to 8 people to ensure a comfortable and safe experience.

Sound healing is a therapeutic practice that uses vibrational frequencies from instruments like singing bowls, gongs, and chimes to restore harmony in the body and mind. These soothing sounds help reduce stress, promote deep relaxation, and support emotional and physical well-being by aligning your energy.

During a sound healing session, vibrations gently guide you into a meditative state, encouraging the release of tension and balancing your inner rhythms. Many people report feeling lighter, calmer, and more centered after just one session.

Curious to experience it yourself? Join our Sound Healing evening and let the calming frequencies wash over you. Whether you're seeking stress relief, better sleep, or simply a moment of peace, this is your opportunity to explore the benefits firsthand. Come relax, recharge, and discover the healing power of sound!

Led by Joël Van der Putten, of Divine Tuning. Joël's mission is to inspire people with a combination of sound, music and ritual work. He understands that by working through sound, directly on these levels, the healing power of the body is activated along with the higher consciousness.

A 4 week Dream Work & Self-Discovery Journey

Note: this is a 4 week group experience, €100 includes all 4 sessions.

Dreams can offer a unique window into your inner world. This small, closed group invites you to explore them in a creative and reflective way, uncovering insights through a series of guided sessions.

Guided by a Jungian approach, this group explores dreams as a symbolic language of the psyche. Through different creative exercises such as drawing, journaling, or poetry, you will learn to engage with your dreams and uncover their deeper meaning.

Each session offers space to reflect, explore, and gradually build a personal connection with your dream world.

This is a closed group experience, meaning the same participants journey together over the full duration. This allows for trust, continuity, and a deeper level of sharing within a safe and contained environment.

- Time: 6:30 to 8:00 PM
- Group Size: Maximum 8 participants
- Approach: Creative exercises, symbolic exploration, and optional sharing
- Preparation: Simply bring yourself; a journal will be provided in the first session
- Refreshments: light snacks & tea will be provided

Session Dates

- Tuesday, 14 July 2026
- Tuesday, 21 July 2026

This group is open to individuals aged 13+ who feel curious about their dreams.

- A willingness to share (at your own pace) within a group setting

She has facilitated workshops internationally, guiding people through processes of self-discovery using art and symbolism.

title: Dying to Talk:  The Mindful Caregiver
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: In the second of our series, Amanda explores the dance of mindful caregiving. Through poetry and meditation, we’ll discuss how mindfulness and self-compassion prevent burnout. Whether you're a family or professional caregiver, join us to find clarity and connection within the storm.✨
description:
Topic:  Dying & the Mindful Caregiver

Dates:  April 20 & July 8

In this second instalment of our mindful workshop series on death, we continue our exploration of end-of-life preparation and the path of the mindful caregiver.

True mindfulness and self-compassion are the two pillars of a stool that becomes complete only when contemplation meets action. This evening, Amanda will discuss the evolving roles of both the dying person and the family caregiver, exploring how these dynamics shift as illness and death progress. This workshop is equally valuable for professional caregivers or those aspiring to the field, offering a "dance" toward clarity, connection, and completion when everyone involved receives the support they need.

Through poetry, guided meditation, and open discussion, we will empower you to:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_4e27f16472b44ba187101db7835d0359~mv2.jpg)

- Integrate Mindfulness: Use daily awareness as a foundation for caregiving.
- Practice Self-Compassion: Build resilience within the caregiving environment.
- Navigate Palliative Care: Understand the nuances and benefits as care transitions toward hospice.
- Support the Spirit: Gain insight into the mental and spiritual needs of those at the end of life.

Join us to gather essential tools for your "caregiving toolbox," transforming a potentially depleting experience into one of hope and resilience.

“There are only four kinds of people in the world—those who have been caregivers, those who are currently caregivers, those who will be caregivers, and those who will need caregivers.” — Rosalynn Carter

“Let there be an opening into the quiet that lies beneath the chaos, where you can find the peace you did not think possible and see what shimmers within the storm.” — John O’Donohue

“Our intent isn’t to feel better, but to get better at feeling.” — Michael Brown

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

summary: In the second of our series, Amanda explores the dance of mindful caregiving. Through poetry and meditation, we’ll discuss how mindfulness and self-compassion prevent burnout. Whether you're a family or professional caregiver, join us to find clarity and connection within the storm.✨
description:
Topic:  Dying & the Mindful Caregiver

In this second instalment of our mindful workshop series on death, we continue our exploration of end-of-life preparation and the path of the mindful caregiver.

True mindfulness and self-compassion are the two pillars of a stool that becomes complete only when contemplation meets action. This evening, Amanda will discuss the evolving roles of both the dying person and the family caregiver, exploring how these dynamics shift as illness and death progress. This workshop is equally valuable for professional caregivers or those aspiring to the field, offering a "dance" toward clarity, connection, and completion when everyone involved receives the support they need.

Through poetry, guided meditation, and open discussion, we will empower you to:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_4e27f16472b44ba187101db7835d0359~mv2.jpg)

- Integrate Mindfulness: Use daily awareness as a foundation for caregiving.
- Practice Self-Compassion: Build resilience within the caregiving environment.
- Navigate Palliative Care: Understand the nuances and benefits as care transitions toward hospice.
- Support the Spirit: Gain insight into the mental and spiritual needs of those at the end of life.

Join us to gather essential tools for your "caregiving toolbox," transforming a potentially depleting experience into one of hope and resilience.

“There are only four kinds of people in the world—those who have been caregivers, those who are currently caregivers, those who will be caregivers, and those who will need caregivers.” — Rosalynn Carter

“Let there be an opening into the quiet that lies beneath the chaos, where you can find the peace you did not think possible and see what shimmers within the storm.” — John O’Donohue

“Our intent isn’t to feel better, but to get better at feeling.” — Michael Brown

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony, The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women of The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a lady shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creators of our deepest hopes and desires.

Through this ceremony, participants are gently guided to release pain and sorrow held within the womb, restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

- The ceremony lasts approximately 90-120 minutes
- Limited to 7 women for an intimate and nurturing circle
- Bring only yourself and your wish to heal your womb
- Come prepared to share openly and receive in sisterhood
- Some reflective journaling will be part of the ceremony
- The event will flow organically, occasionally the event goes to 3 hours
- (Optional) Wear something that makes you feel feminine or honours your divine femininity

This ceremony will be offered regularly at The Hague Natural Health Centre, inviting women to reconnect with their innate feminine power and the healing wisdom of the Earth.

🌸  In healing our own wombs...we contribute to healing the womb of the Great Mother Earth.

description:
Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom

Note:  The meal consists of a vegetarian soup, salad and light bites. We do our best to accommodate the various dietary restrictions by keeping it simple and light.

This is a monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the Tuesday or Wednesday each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. As those who hold space for others, we also need a place to be held, witnessed, and supported.

Each month, we will explore a topic chosen to spark insight into both our personal and professional lives. To begin, we will focus on themes such as Gender (May), Growth (June), Energy (July). These topics will likely change, allowing the circle to evolve organically with the needs and interests of the attendees, if you have a topic you'd like to discuss, pease send us a message.

Our aim is simple:

👉 Learn from one another

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

👉 Support each other

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. The conversations tend to go deep and leave attendee's with food for thought long after the evening is over - please know that it is a safe space where conversations should remain only within that space.

Your hosts for the evening will be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

title: Dying to Talk:  Grief as a gateway to Hope
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: In this evenings topic, Amanda explores the terrain of grief as a garden to be tended. From diagnosis to loss, we’ll discuss the six needs of grief and use creative rituals to bridge pain toward hope. Join us over summer soup to learn how the heart mends and grows through grieving. 🌿
description:
Topic:  Grief as a gateway to Hope

Dates:  May 11 & August 24

In this third topic in our death awareness series, we venture into the terrain of grief and explore what arises when we purposefully process loss in our day-to-day lives.

Grief often begins long before a loved one passes, taking us on an unanticipated physical and existential journey. If we tend to our grief like a garden, it reveals its potential for growth. It may arrive timidly upon a diagnosis, hurriedly as an end nears, or suddenly with unexpected loss. Most importantly, grief forces us to pay attention by slowing... us... down.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_de1f6eb5422846788026f5025627d953~mv2.jpg)

Together, we will explore the different dimensions of loss—relational, functional, material, and the shifting of roles. We will discuss the "six needs of grief," understand grief as a reservoir, and find ourselves held within the intimacy of a safe, supportive container. We will also introduce creative rituals as "helpers", tools designed to bridge the gap between grief and a sense of healing and hope.

Over a bowl of fresh summer soup, Amanda will facilitate a deeper understanding of the subtle needs of grief. We will explore how being present in the body and in nature can support us, showing us how the heart can grow even in the midst of pain. Here, we learn that suffering can be a wise companion, helping us tend to and mend the holes left in our hearts.

“Go into your grief, for there your soul will grow.” - Carl Jung

“Grief is life turning toward itself,” Trauma Stewardship by Laura van Dernoot Lipsky

“If you live deeper in the Heart, the mirror gets clearer and clearer.” - Rumi

Participants should be at least six months past a significant grief experience, or receiving individual support before the workshop. This helps ensure everyone is appropriately supported during the event.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

summary: In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll learn how to recognise, name, and work with the different aspects of your inner world, so they can start supporting you rather than holding you back.
description:
Introduction to Star Psychology ✨

We’ll gently introduce the foundations of astro-psychology, a unique approach that blends astrology, Human Design, and psychology. No prior knowledge is needed. Using your birth chart as a simple map of your inner world, you’ll begin to understand your patterns, strengths, challenges, and deeper motivations in a clear and accessible way.

This workshop offers a welcoming introduction to Star Psychology and its rich world of inner archetypes. Developed by Lysanne Sizoo, this approach combines both nature and nurture, bringing together practical insight and intuitive understanding in a way that feels grounded, creative, and easy to relate to.

What you’ll explore

During the workshop, you’ll be introduced to the foundations of your birth chart and how it can serve as a simple map of your inner landscape.

Participants will learn about:

• Your two core inner archetypes and what they mean for you

• How to understand and work with inner conflicts

• A simple way to make decisions that feel more aligned

• How to step into the role of the observer rather than getting lost in thoughts or emotions

You will also receive:

• A simple personal overview of your Star Psychology birth chart

• A recording of the guided meditation from the workshop 🧘

What to expect

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. Through a combination of explanation, reflection, and guided meditation, you’ll begin to recognise the patterns and inner dynamics that shape how you think, feel, and make decisions.

About your host

Lysanne Sizoo is a psychosynthesis psychotherapist and the founder of the Star Psychology method. For over twenty-five years, she has guided individuals through a holistic approach that connects psychology, astrology, and human design.

Important information

When booking, please share your date of birth, time of birth (if possible), and place of birth so your personal overview can be prepared.

To allow time for this preparation, registration closes three days before the event.

description:
About the Event:

The Life Transitions Circle is a safe, compassionate space for people who are navigating significant life changes and are looking to pause, reflect, and reconnect with themselves. This is a series of 4 in person events with the aim of helping to create deeper connection through face-to-face conversations.

Are you navigating a turning point: after a breakup, a move abroad, a career shift, or simply questioning the path you’re on?

These sessions are about being heard, understood, and supported by others who know what it feels like to stand at a crossroads.

✅ What to expect

Together we create a confidential, respectful space where you can:

💫  Process the emotional impact of change

💫  Develop greater resilience during periods of uncertainty

💫  Reconnect with your inner resources and strengths

💫  Explore practical and emotional ways to move forward

💫  Build meaningful connections with people who understand your journey

Each meeting includes guided reflection, facilitated group discussion, practical exercises, and opportunities to learn from one another’s experiences.

✅ Meeting schedule

You are welcome to attend regularly or join whenever you need additional support during a challenging period. Schedule for the upcoming 4 sessions:

Sept 10

Oct 1

Oct 29

Nov 19

The circle is open to anyone experiencing a major life transition, including:

🌀 Relocation or moving to a new country

🌀 Divorce or break-up

🌀 Career change or job loss

🌀 Burnout or returning to work after illness

🌀 Becoming a parent or adjusting to an empty nest

🌀 Loss of a loved one

🌀 Retirement

🌀 Any significant life change that leaves you asking, “What now?”

You don’t have to have it all figured out.

Transitions can feel overwhelming, but they can also become powerful turning points.

✨ We invite you to step into our caring circle. Sometimes the greatest transformation begins simply by sitting in a room with people who truly understand and help you reconnect with your own inner guidance.

✅ Pricing

€35,00 per session

In order to give you the opportunity to experience the atmosphere, meet the group, and see whether the circle feels right for you, we have a flexible pricing approach. If you decide to continue after attending a session, please reach out to Nadia directly about her discount packages at: nadiaeliseeva89@gmail.com

About your Host:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

The event is facilitated by Nadia Eliseeva, ICF-certified coach with background in psychology, trained in Systemic Constellations therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being. She regularly conducts therapy circles, Individual and Group Constellations Workshops, holding a precise and respectful space for deep systemic work.

summary: Join us for a unique transformational experience exploring the hidden patterns that shape your relationship with money. Gain fresh insights into abundance, self-worth, and financial growth through guided reflection and interactive play.
description:
#### The Territory of Money – Transformational Game 💰

A transformational psychological game is a guided self-discovery experience that combines coaching, psychology, reflection, and symbolic interaction.

Rather than focusing on competition, it helps participants uncover subconscious patterns, limiting beliefs, emotional triggers, and hidden behaviours that influence everyday decisions.

Through questions, symbols, and guided reflection, participants gain fresh insights, greater self-awareness, and a deeper understanding of what may be holding them back, from emotional blocks and family dynamics to long-standing survival patterns.

The Territory of Money

It is a deep psychological journey designed to help you explore the hidden dynamics behind income, financial growth, overspending, or fear of instability – in an interactive and experiential way.

Through the game process, participants begin to recognise the internal patterns influencing their financial decisions, energy level, and capacity to receive and hold money.

What to Expect:

- Duration: Approximately 4 hours
- Group Size: Limited to 2–8 participants for a personal experience
- Includes: Tea and healthy snacks
- Language: English
- Impact: Greater awareness and clarity around your relationship with money
- Investment: €55

Is this event for me?

This workshop is ideal for adults who would like to better understand their relationship with money and develop a healthier financial mindset.

- Expand your capacity to earn, receive, and manage money
- Develop a healthier and more supportive relationship with finances
- Identify limiting beliefs and emotional blocks around money
- Replace unhelpful financial patterns with empowering ones
- Approach money with greater ease, trust, and confidence
- Recognise new opportunities for financial growth and abundance

Please note that a minimum of 3 people is required for the event to proceed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

Meet Your Host

Nadia Eliseeva is an ICF-certified coach with a background in psychology and training in Systemic Constellations Therapy and Psychosomatics. Her work focuses on uncovering the subconscious dynamics that influence both emotional and physical wellbeing.

Through transformational games, constellation workshops, and individual sessions, Nadia creates a safe and confidential space for deep self-exploration, helping participants gain clarity, awareness, and meaningful personal insights.
