title: Leela & Constellations Day Retreat
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: A full-day mini-retreat is an immersive experience bringing together two powerful transformational tools — the ancient game of Leela & Systemic Constellations. A carefully held space to work with your personal inquiry within a supportive and confidential group field of 6 participants.
description:
Leela & Constellations Day ✨

Are you feeling stuck in repetitive patterns, seeking a deeper understanding of your

life’s direction, or standing at a crossroads? We invite you to a deep Immersion into

your inner landscape. Together, the two powerful transformational tools — the ancient

game of Leela & Systemic Constellations – will help you uncover the hidden causes

and map out a new vector for your movement forward.

☸️ Leela: The Mirror of the Soul

Leela is a sacred game of consciousness, rooted in at least two millennia of ancient

India’s wisdom traditions. It unfolds through 72 states of life, reflecting the full spectrum of human experience: limitations, resources, lessons, blind spots, and possibilities.

As you move through the game with your personal intention, your inner journey is

mirrored with remarkable precision. Complex situations begin to untangle. The game

provides the answers that resonate with your true Self, helping you feel a clearer

sense of direction.

Leela is not about predicting the future. It is about illuminating your present.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_5575a54a240b4b0d8f6d6d67b86b0118~mv2.jpg)

Systemic Constellations: Revealing the Hidden

This profound experiential method offers a window into the subconscious. It combines the depth of psychology, the structure of system-thinking, and a practical approach. Through visual representations, by working with deep emotional and energetic connections in the Field, the hidden dynamics are brought to light.

Patterns of loyalty, unconscious entanglements, and internal conflicts that usually

operate beneath the surface of awareness can be observed directly. From this new

perspective, an inner shift becomes possible — and when the inner configuration

changes, external circumstances begin to reorganise as well.

✅ What to expect

This mini-retreat offers a supportive space to reconnect with your own inner guidance,

a day of deep insight and meaningful internal shifts. For this full immersion we

recommend the maximum of 6 participants.

In the morning, we journey through the symbolic “Map of Life” with Leela.

As you move across its 72 states of consciousness, your personal question unfolds in

a structured yet intuitive way.

In the afternoon, we move into Constellations, to work on the inquiries and patterns

that surfaced during the game.

One by one, the participants will bring their question, and the others will step into

representative roles, embodying elements of his/her subconscious. Through their responses, the subtle relational and energetic dynamics surrounding the Questioner’s situation become tangible and observable.

Together, these two modalities create a powerful arch. Leela offers perspective and orientation, a high-level overview of your path; Constellations bring depth, structural clarity and a deep-dive into the roots of your

challenges.

You leave with a grounded understanding of what needs to shift at its roots. Patterns become visible. Resources emerge. The broader architecture of your current life chapter and the next steps begins to take

shape. How the Day will unfold:

10:00 — Arrival & Welcome tea with healthy snacks

10:30–13:30 — Opening Circle & Immersion into Leela, the game of Self-Knowledge

13:30–14:30 — Lunch break

14:30–15:00 — Transition & settling into Constellations space

15:00–18:00 — Systemic Constellation work on the questions that arise during Leela

18:00–19:00 — Integration & closing circle

This workshop will be facilitated by:

Alina Volodina — transformational Leela game guide and practitioner of regressive

hypnotherapy. She is also trained in Universal Therapy (Talpis method), guiding clients

into deep subconscious processes and inner realignment.

Nadia Eliseeva – ICF-certified coach and psychologist, trained in Systemic

Constellations therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the

subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being.

Language: This event is bilingual, held in Russian and English. No prior experience

with Leela or Constellations is necessary—only your openness and willingness to

explore.

✨ We invite you to dedicate this day to yourself — and step into the circle of deep

exploration together.

description:
Healthy Narcissism: Reclaiming Self-Worth Beyond Achievement

A Presentation and Inner Exploration

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_b30c6bfc13784c29ad91be9b32a538ce~mv2.png)

We all long to feel worthy—not because of what we achieve, but because of who we are. Yet for many of us, our sense of self-worth becomes tied to success, approval, or the roles we play in our relationships.

Together we will explore how these patterns develop and how returning to healthy narcissism allows us to reclaim a stable and authentic sense of self-worth.

Lysanne will explain how the narcissistic wound develops within our earliest relationships. She explores the full spectrum of narcissistic adaptations—from self-inflation to self-deflation—and brings these concepts to life by sharing her own experience of growing up in a narcissistically wounded family system.

When our sense of self-worth is deflated, we often find ourselves drawn into relationships

with people whose self-worth depends on inflation, admiration, or control. In these co-

dependent dynamics, self-worth becomes the toxic currency of love. Understanding your

own pattern is the first step towards breaking free and rediscovering your value—not

because of what you achieve, but simply because of who you are.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_78532442447742a3aad585d680a06544~mv2.jpeg)

Held in a small group, this workshop offers a calm, supportive and confidential environment

for personal reflection and shared insights. Through guided exercises and discussion, you

will be invited to explore these dynamics at your own pace, with space to reflect on what

feels meaningful and relevant for you.

description:
CONSTELLATIONS WORKSHOP

Self-Acceptance

Very often, the way we treat ourselves mirrors early relational dynamics. We may carry parental criticism as our inner voice. We may remain loyal to family narratives of struggle, modesty, or self-sacrifice. We may unconsciously reject parts of ourselves that once felt unsafe to express.

This workshop is for you if:

👉 You struggle with harsh self-judgment

👉You tie your worth to performance or productivity

👉 You feel persistent shame or “not enoughness”

👉 You sabotage success or intimacy

👉 You long for inner steadiness, entangled in constant self-correction

Through Systemic constellations, we externalise the inner voices. Parts of you that

criticise, protect, strive, or withdraw can be represented and observed. This creates

space between identity and conditioning — allowing a new internal order to emerge.

What to expect

Using the Systemic Constellations method, participants step into Representative roles that reflect aspects of the Questioner’s internal system. Their embodied responses provide insight into subconscious dynamics shaping his/her self-perception. The process is experiential and clarifying — it offers diagnostic insight into the underlying dynamics shaping your current challenge, functioning as a focused exploration that makes hidden patterns visible and clarifies where deeper work or realignment may be needed.

We work on a first-registered basis and will hold as many constellations as time allows, understanding that not everyone may have the opportunity to bring their personal inquiry into the centre of the circle as Questioner.

During the workshop, we will:

👉 Identify the origin of your inner critic

👉 Recognise loyalties that maintain self-rejection

👉  Restore a balanced relationship between strength and vulnerability

👉  Support a grounded, embodied sense of self-worth

The workshop is facilitated by Nadia Eliseeva, ICF-certified coach with background in psychology, trained in Systemic Constellations therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being. She regularly conducts Constellations Workshops, holding a precise and respectful space for deep systemic work.

English-spoken. No prior experience with Systemic Constellations is necessary – only your

openness and willingness to explore.

Soul Suppers

Shared Meals & Shared Wisdom

Note:  The meal consists of a vegetarian soup, salad and light bites. We do our best to accommodate the various dietary restrictions by keeping it simple and light.

This is a monthly gathering created exclusively for practitioners who support the healing and growth of others — from therapists and psychologists to medical, holistic, and spiritually oriented professionals. Meeting on the Tuesday or Wednesday each month, this intimate circle is intentionally limited in size to foster depth, honesty, and connection. As those who hold space for others, we also need a place to be held, witnessed, and supported.

Each month, we will explore a topic chosen to spark insight into both our personal and professional lives. To begin, we will focus on themes such as Energy (September), Gender (October), Plant Medicine (November), Holidays (December). These topics will likely change, allowing the circle to evolve organically with the needs and interests of the attendees, if you have a topic you'd like to discuss, pease send us a message.

Our aim is simple:

👉 Learn from one another

👉 Share experiences

👉 Cultivate collective wisdom.

👉 Support each other

Above all, this is a respectful and compassionate space,  one where practitioners can grow, reflect, and feel supported as humans, not just professionals. The conversations tend to go deep and leave attendee's with food for thought long after the evening is over - please know that it is a safe space where conversations should remain only within that space.

Your hosts for the evening will be typically be Sandra Quist, Homeopath & Energy Medicine Practitioner and Camilla Manchur, Psychologist & Art Therapist. However, occasionally one of the other therapists from our team might co-host as well. We will be there to facilitate but not run the entire conversation, we encourage people to come with an open mind to listen and share perspectives to health.

summary: Ready to build your family’s natural medicine chest? Join our free learning series at The Hague Natural Health Centre to master tissue salts, flower essences & homeopathic first aid with Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner, Sandra Quist.
description:
Empower Your Family’s Health with Natural Remedies

Take control of your family's wellness with safe, gentle, and easy-to-use natural remedies. Join us for a relaxed, educational series designed to equip parents and individuals with practical tools to support the body and mind naturally.

Your host is Sandra Quist, a Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner with over 12 years of teaching experience including 7 years of clinical experience. This informal workshop series aims to provide people with a basic understanding of natural remedies so that they do not feel so mysterious. We aim to have fun so bring your questions no matter how silly or serious they might be!

### What You Will Learn

The series is divided into 3 modules, each focusing on a different way of approaching health via physical symptoms, emotional symptoms and most often both at the same time. Although each module can stand alone, it is recommended that you join at least two of the same modules in order to give you a strong understanding of feeling confident to begin using them on your own. It is the first time we host this learning series at the Natural Health Centre so the timing and content may vary slightly depending on the audience and pace of questions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_a5d96a9632bb44ff8481f8f18b4c1717~mv2.png)

#### Oct 19 & Nov 16:

#### Introduction to Schuessler Tissue Salts 
(Physical Body Support)

Learn how these 12 essential mineral salts support physical functions and help manage everyday ailments. Tissue Salts are bascially energetic versions of electrolytes. This workshop covers:

- What are tissue salts and why they are vital to cellular health.
- The 12 core tissue salts and common combination remedies,
- Practical tools for common conditions: colds, minor asthma support, bedwetting, chickenpox, measles, colic, cramps, fevers, hemorrhoids, hair loss, hay fever, and brain fog.

#### Dec 7 & Jan 11:

#### Flower Essences (Emotional Balance)

Discover gentle flower remedies designed to support emotional well-being and stress management.

- Fundamentals of flower essences and how they are prepared.
- Practical applications of traditional Bach Flower Essences.
- Introduction to pre-combined flower essences for quick and easy daily use.

#### Feb 8:

#### Homeopathic First Aid (Acute Care)

Introduction to the basics of homeopathy and managing everyday injuries, acute illnesses, and sudden stresses.

- Core principles and philosophy behind homeopathic remedies.
- How to select and administer remedies for colds, emotional distress, minor injuries, sunburn, food poisoning, grief, and more.
- There's so much you can do to support your family with natural remedies, start to learn about it!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_679501fba6b24163a9402644af9c3014~mv2.png)

### Prerequisites & Attendance

- Registration Required: This is a free event, however due to limited capacity, you must register for each event. We also ask that you kindly cancel your attendance if you are unable to attend in order to allow someone else to take your place.
- Who it’s for: Open to everyone, especially mothers, fathers, and caregivers looking to educate themselves on natural health. No prior experience is required, just an open and curious mind.
- Format: You are welcome to attend individual sessions as your schedule allows. However, to get the most value and to participate in Q&A sessions, we strongly recommend attending both months of a specific topic (e.g., both Tissue Salt modules).
The intention is to have fun, ask questions, let your curiosty lead you to learn something new that can actually support you and your family in a natural, sustainable and non-invasive way.

title: Constellations Workshop: Family Patterns
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands

summary: How much of the way you live and make decisions is truly yours? And how much has been shaped by your family? This exploratory Constellations Workshop will uncover family patterns, roles, beliefs, and loyalties that influence your behaviour and choices, creating space for a more authentic path.
description:
This workshop is for you if:

- You notice the same relationship, career, money, or emotional patterns repeating in your life

- You feel responsible for your family members, struggle to set boundaries, or find it difficult to choose yourself

- You recognize beliefs or expectations inherited from your family, yet still feel unable to move beyond them

- You want to understand why certain choices feel charged, restricted, or strangely difficult

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_9e6fcb6d487f47528ffd8d4231614201~mv2.jpg)

Family Patterns workshop offers a space to explore what belongs to you and what may have been carried from your family system. Through the methodology of Systemic Constellations, hidden patterns, roles, beliefs, and loyalties become visible. When we can see these dynamics with compassion, new possibilities begin to emerge – choices rooted in the present rather than inherited from the past.

During the workshop, we will:

💫  Explore inherited beliefs, expectations, roles, and unspoken loyalties

💫  Bring to light family patterns and scenarios influencing your behaviour and choices

💫  Notice where you may be carrying emotions or responsibilities that are not yours

💫  Create space for healthier boundaries and choices that feel authentically your own

What Participants can expect:

A constellation begins with a Questioner bringing a personal issue they would like to understand more deeply. Other participants (Representatives) are then invited to step into roles connected to the Questioner’s family system members, elements, or themes. Without being given the full story, Representatives may notice physical sensations, emotions, impulses, or shifts in how they relate to one another. As the constellation unfolds, these responses can reveal the subconscious structure beneath the issue — including repeated roles, inherited beliefs, hidden loyalties, exclusions, unresolved relationships – allowing the Questioner to see their situation from a new perspective and recognise where change may become possible.

We will work with as many Questioners as the workshop time allows, understanding that not everyone may have the opportunity to bring their personal inquiry into the centre of the circle. The constellations will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Taking part as a Representative, however, is a very meaningful experience in itself, as the themes that emerge often resonate with different participants in the group and their own stories.

Prior to the event, you will receive a confirmation message (e-mail) from Nadia with all the details.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to step into this circle of exploration and meet your family story with curiosity, compassion, and courage – in a safe, respectful, and confidential space.

Meet your host:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Systemic Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in uncovering hidden patterns, releasing inner tensions, and finding a freer and more authentic relationship with

themselves and their family story.

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. summary: Throughout the month of October, bring a photo of a loved one that has passed and add them to our Ancestor Altar. Or write a message that you did not have a chance to say - we will include them in our ceremony on Day of the Dead / All Saints Day.
description:
Día de los Muertos:

Honouring Our Ancestors

Join us for our very first Día de los Muertos gathering, a heartfelt space to acknowledge, remember, and hold gratitude for those who walked before us. Whether you miss their comforting presence or seek peace with complex relationships, we aim to create a moment where you can simply come and send a note to your loved one or honour their contribution to your own life.

How often do we long to feel our loved ones’ presence, wish we had said something before they passed, or simply reflect on shared memories?

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6bd9cb33cd884850b762f39cecc413bd~mv2.png)

Every ancestor, through their gifts, wisdom, or patterns passed through the generations , helped shape the lives we live today. Whether we realise it or not, we are the children they hoped for, the ones they wished would have a better life than their own. This month, we invite you to participate in whatever way feels right for you. Whether that is bringing a photo, leaving a message, joining the ceremony, or all of the above.

Throughout October: The Ancestor Altar & Blessing Scrolls

October 1 – October 30

Drop-in Hours: Mondays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays | 13:00 – 14:30

Help us build a beautiful, sacred altar together. You are warmly invited to bring a copy of a loved one’s photo to be placed on our Ancestor Altar, where it will receive continuous blessings throughout the month. Alternatively, you can slip your photo into an envelope and drop it into our postbox and we will include it in our altar.

If you wish, it's also possible to write a blessing, a tribute, or a personal message to your loved one on a tiny rice-paper scroll. These scrolls will be safely kept in our blessing jar and included in our November 1 ceremony.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6b270025456645ae8eeb9a6ee0655639~mv2.png)

A Note on Photos & Privacy: Please send or bring copies only, as photos cannot be returned. On the back of the photo, write your loved one’s first name. All personal messages written on the scrolls are completely private, and will simply be held in the jar until the ceremony.

November 1
Gratitude & Ancestor Ceremony

Time: 14:00 – 16:30 / 17:00 (2 to 3 hours, depending on group size and weather)

Together, we will gather to create a sacred space to offer gratitude, honour our lineage, and invite our ancestors to join us.

- Part 1: Sharing Circle & Witnessing We will facilitate a gentle sharing circle. Everyone will have the opportunity to share a bit about what brings them to the space. There is no pressure at all, you are welcome to simply sit in as a silent witness and participate without speaking.
- Part 2: Ancestral Blessing CeremonyNext, we will lead a ceremony to honour the ancestors, send our messages and blessings to the ancestral realm, and invite their presence into our gathering. Together, we will hold space for gratitude, past lessons, and future blessings.
- Part 3: Release the blessings into the ocean(Scheveningen Beach) (Optional & Weather Permitting)We will take our sustainable tributes and rice-paper scrolls on a reflective walk to Scheveningen Beach. Here, we will release our blessings into the ocean, allowing the waters to receive and carry them outward. (Please note: Walking to the beach is optional. You are welcome to stay for the ceremony and depart before the walk if you prefer.)

Event Details & Registration

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_bc38da42d04048a282e8d51cb444fda3~mv2.png)

- Cost: Free to place a photo on the altar or write a message.
- Ceremony Attendance: Free, but registration is required due to limited space.

We look forward to sharing this sacred month with you, honoring our loved ones, and building a memorable altar together. You are welcome here, just as you are.

title: The Territory of Money: interactive, experiential workshop
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Get Tickets
summary: What if you could understand and improve your relationship with money without another spreadsheet, another list of rules, or another conversation about what you should be doing differently? We invite you to explore your financial patterns through play and fun.
description:
#### The Territory of Money – Interactive and experiential workshop💰

Money is a serious topic. Sometimes, we take it so seriously that stress, anxiety and fear get

in the way of seeing things clearly and making decisions that truly serve us.

When it comes to money, many of us tend to go to one of two extremes. We stay in our

heads, trying to make the most rational, informed and responsible decisions. Or we avoid the

subject altogether because it brings up feelings we'd rather not deal with: guilt, shame, fear,

frustration, overwhelm or uncertainty.

And somewhere in between, we repeat familiar patterns. Every. Single. Day.

What if you could explore relationship with money in a completely different way -

through play & fun?

We warmly invite you to join us for an interactive, experiential workshop combining The

Territory of Money, transformational board game facilitated by Nadia Eliseeva, with Andreea

Birou's financial well being, counseling and coaching approach.

Through the game, you'll explore different dimensions of your relationship with money,

notice how you make choices, respond to financial challenges, receive, hold and give money,

use your resources and interact with others.

After the game, we'll reflect on what you've noticed and connect those discoveries to your

real-life financial challenges. Using guided powerful questions and Andreea's I GROW FIN

method approach, you'll explore what is working well, what may be holding you back, and

what new possibilities and opportunities are available to you.

This workshop is for you if…

✅ You keep repeating money habits you'd like to change

✅ You overthink financial decisions or avoid them altogether

✅ You want to understand what really lies behind your money choices

✅ You're ready for a fresh perspective on earning, spending, saving and financial security

✅ You want to develop healthier money habits that support your life and goals.

What to expect

🎲 An interactive board game full of choices, challenges and discoveries

💬 Guided reflection connecting the game to your everyday financial life

💡 Meaningful conversations in a supportive, non-judgemental space

🌱 Fresh insights into your money habits, strengths and opportunities

🎯 Practical coaching to help you identify opportunities and your next steps you can take into

your everyday financial life

You'll be invited to share and reflect at your own comfort level; personal experiences are

treated with respect and confidentiality.

What you'll take away

- Understand your money habits: Recognise patterns in how you earn, spend, save

and make financial decisions.

- See what influences your choices: Explore how your emotions, beliefs and

everyday reactions affect the way you handle money.

- Recognise what's already working: Identify your strengths, resources and habits

that you can build on.

- Discover new possibilities: Find different ways to approach the money challenges

you're facing.

- Know your next step: Leave with practical ideas and one or two actions you can

take to build healthier money habits that support your life and goals.

And perhaps most importantly, a little more curiosity, a little less judgement, and permission

not to take yourself quite so seriously.

After all, it's a board game and learning about yourself can be both meaningful and fun.

You don't need to be good with money, know anything about finance, or have played the

game before. Just bring an open mind and your willingness to explore.

Meet your Hosts

Nadia Eliseeva is Life Energy coach (ICF ACC) with background in psychology, trained in

Systemic Constellations Therapy and Psychosomatics. Her specialty lies in uncovering the

subconscious dynamics and blocks that impact mental and physical well-being. She regularly

holds Constellations workshops, conducts individual sessions and transformational games,

creating a confidential environment for deep exploration.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

Andreea Birou is a financial wellbeing coach, consultant and former audit professional with

over 20 years of experience across finance, audit and business. By combining financial

expertise with transformational coaching, she helps people recognise and understand their

money patterns, make sense of their financial choices and turn insights into practical steps

towards a healthier relationship with money and greater financial well-being.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_763247bbeac8435fa5f724daa717e10e~mv2.jpeg)

✨ Come as you are. Play, discover, ask, reflect. And leave with a fresh perspective on your

money, greater clarity and one step towards a healthier relationship with money.

title: The Rite of the Womb
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Get Tickets
summary: A Ceremony honouring our ancestors, the present moment and sending blessings to the future.  Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra is honoured to share this powerful ceremony with the women of The Hague.
description:
### The Rite of the Womb Ceremony 🌿

Join us for a sacred and heart-opening ceremony, The Rite of the Womb, a blessing passed down through a lineage of women who freed themselves from fear and pain.

Recently initiated into the Munay-Ki rites, Sandra Quist is honoured to share this powerful transmission of healing and remembrance with the women of The Hague.

✨ The womb is not a place to store fear and pain; the womb is to create and give birth to life. ✨

The Rite of the Womb was first bestowed by a lineage of women through the Spirit of the Amazon jungle to a lady shaman, who became its first keeper and guardian. This sacred gift of healing and life belongs to every woman who wishes to receive it. Together, we form a lineage of women who remember that we did not come to suffer, but to be the Creators of our deepest hopes and desires.

Through this ceremony, participants are gently guided to release pain and sorrow held within the womb, restoring its natural wisdom and creative energy. As the womb heals, it becomes a centre of vitality, joy, and life once more.

✨ What to Expect:

- The ceremony lasts approximately 90-120 minutes
- Limited to 7 women for an intimate and nurturing circle
- Bring only yourself and your wish to heal your womb
- Come prepared to share openly and receive in sisterhood
- Some reflective journaling will be part of the ceremony
- The event will flow organically, occasionally the event goes to 3 hours
- (Optional) Wear something that makes you feel feminine or honours your divine femininity

This ceremony will be offered regularly at The Hague Natural Health Centre, inviting women to reconnect with their innate feminine power and the healing wisdom of the Earth.

🌸  In healing our own wombs...we contribute to healing the womb of the Great Mother Earth.

title: Constellations Workshop: Inner Critic
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Get Tickets
summary: “I’m not good enough. I should have done better.” Sound familiar? Explore where your Inner Critic comes from, what triggers it, and how you can begin changing your relationship with it.
description:
This workshop is for you if:

🌀 You regularly judge yourself or feel that nothing you do is ever good enough

🌀 You overthink your choices and fear making mistakes

🌀 You compare yourself with others and quickly notice your own shortcomings

🌀 You struggle to accept praise, recognise your achievements, or feel proud of yourself

🌀 You want to understand what triggers your Inner Critic and why its voice becomes louder in certain situations

The Inner Critic workshop offers a space to explore the origins of this voice and the subconscious dynamics that continue to give it power. Through Systemic Constellations, we will look beyond its critical words and explore what it is trying to protect you from.

Only when this inner voice becomes visible, is it possible to separate inherited judgements and expectations from your own authentic voice.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/11062b_9fe8cf7ac275438cafa34f90833b0230~mv2.jpg)

During the workshop, we will:

✨  Identify the situations, relationships, and emotions that trigger your Inner Critic

✨  Explore where it comes from and whose voice it may carry

✨  Bring to light the fears, expectations, and subconscious beliefs beneath its criticism

✨  Understand the protective role the Inner Critic may have taken on

✨  Create space for a more compassionate, encouraging, and supportive inner voice

✅  What to expect:

We will begin with each participant bringing a personal question into the circle, to be explored one by one. For each inquiry, other participants (Representatives) will be selected to step into the roles identified by the Facilitator – the key elements of the Questioner’s system. They will be placed intuitively in the space, and then the Questioner steps outside the constellation to observe.

The Representatives are given no background information. From their positions, they begin to notice physical sensations, emotions, impulses, and responses to one another. These reactions create a visible map of the subconscious patterns within the Questioner’s system. Guided by what emerges, the Constellation reveals the origins and function of the critical voice and explores its inner dynamic, allowing the Questioner to start building a different relationship with their Inner Critic.

We will work with as many Questioners as the workshop time allows, understanding that not everyone may have the opportunity to bring their personal inquiry into the centre of the circle. The constellations will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Taking part as a Representative, however, is a very meaningful experience in itself, as the themes that emerge often resonate with different participants in the group and their own stories.

English-spoken. No prior experience with System Constellations is necessary – only your openness and willingness to explore.

✨ We invite you to enter this circle with curiosity and compassion — and discover the voice within you that can guide and support you instead of judging you.

Meet your host:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_07ca3db5733e4c7a96dad5aaaa7b8db4~mv2.jpeg)

This workshop will be led by Nadia Eliseeva, a trained Systemic Constellations therapist who regularly facilitates interactive sessions. This unique method offers a window into the subconscious by working with deep emotional and energetic connections. Through visual representation, Systemic Constellations support participants in recognising hidden dynamics, releasing inner tensions, and developing a more authentic and compassionate relationship with themselves.

Prior to the event, you will receive a confirmation message (e-mail) from Nadia with all the details.

description:
Empower Your Family’s Health with Natural Remedies

Take control of your family's wellness with safe, gentle, and easy-to-use natural remedies. Join us for a relaxed, educational series designed to equip parents and individuals with practical tools to support the body and mind naturally.

Your host is Sandra Quist, a Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner with over 12 years of teaching experience including 7 years of clinical experience. This informal workshop series aims to provide people with a basic understanding of natural remedies so that they do not feel so mysterious. We aim to have fun so bring your questions no matter how silly or serious they might be!

### What You Will Learn

The series is divided into 3 modules, each focusing on a different way of approaching health via physical symptoms, emotional symptoms and most often both at the same time. Although each module can stand alone, it is recommended that you join at least two of the same modules in order to give you a strong understanding of feeling confident to begin using them on your own. It is the first time we host this learning series at the Natural Health Centre so the timing and content may vary slightly depending on the audience and pace of questions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_a5d96a9632bb44ff8481f8f18b4c1717~mv2.png)

#### Introduction to Schuessler Tissue Salts 
(Physical Body Support)

Learn how these 12 essential mineral salts support physical functions and help manage everyday ailments. Tissue Salts are bascially energetic versions of electrolytes. This workshop covers:

- What are tissue salts and why they are vital to cellular health.
- The 12 core tissue salts and common combination remedies,
- Practical tools for common conditions: colds, minor asthma support, bedwetting, chickenpox, measles, colic, cramps, fevers, hemorrhoids, hair loss, hay fever, and brain fog.

#### Dec 7 & Jan 11:

#### Flower Essences (Emotional Balance)

Discover gentle flower remedies designed to support emotional well-being and stress management.

- Fundamentals of flower essences and how they are prepared.
- Practical applications of traditional Bach Flower Essences.
- Introduction to pre-combined flower essences for quick and easy daily use.

#### Feb 8:

#### Homeopathic First Aid (Acute Care)

Introduction to the basics of homeopathy and managing everyday injuries, acute illnesses, and sudden stresses.

- Core principles and philosophy behind homeopathic remedies.
- How to select and administer remedies for colds, emotional distress, minor injuries, sunburn, food poisoning, grief, and more.
- There's so much you can do to support your family with natural remedies, start to learn about it!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_679501fba6b24163a9402644af9c3014~mv2.png)

title: Revisiting insecure attachment styles.
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Tickets are not on sale | See other events
summary: Do you find it hard to trust your partner and friends? Do you cling to them out of fear of abandonment, or do you prefer to keep them at a distance? Or maybe you do both!
description:
Revisiting insecure attachment styles.

Reparenting your inner child

Why can you feel completely safe with one person, yet anxious, clingy or distant with another?

Attachment is the way we learn to seek safety and connection in our relationships. We once tended to think of people as having one fixed attachment style. Today, our understanding is more nuanced: different early relationships can create different internal working models of safety and connection, and different relationships in adult life may activate different parts of that attachment system.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_7a8495028d9943b6bc628c899d571c14~mv2.png)

This means you may feel secure and trusting with some people, while others awaken a deep insecurity that leaves you feeling clingy, standoffish, or even both.

And that can be really confusing.

The important thing is that insecure attachment patterns are not character flaws. They are adaptations: ways in which we learned to navigate our relational world and protect ourselves when safety or connection felt uncertain.

We may not be responsible for how those patterns originally developed, but as adults we can take responsibility for healing them.

Through insight, self-compassion and what is sometimes called reparenting, we can learn to recognise the younger parts of ourselves that still seek reassurance, protection or connection from others, and gradually develop a greater sense of security within ourselves.

Together, we will explore the different attachment patterns and how they can show up in friendships, intimate relationships and other important bonds. Lysanne will offer an accessible introduction to current thinking about attachment, followed by an inner exploration of your own relational patterns and how you can begin to create greater security from within.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_65c807aa15124fc3b7e38d818cf135e9~mv2.png)

Held in a small group, this workshop offers a calm, supportive and confidential environment for personal reflection and shared insights. Through guided exercises and discussion, you will be invited to explore these dynamics at your own pace, with space to reflect on what feels meaningful and relevant for you.

What Participants can expect:

This workshop is for anyone who is curious about understanding themselves more deeply. Whether you recognise patterns of anxious or avoidant relating, over analysing and/or people-pleasing, our main aim is to help you develop a kinder and more authentic relationship to your fearful inner child. No previous knowledge of psychology is required.

In this workshop we bring the issue of attachment and bonding right back to our own experience of relationships. We begin to take full responsibility for the choices we make and don’t hold others responsible for reparenting our inner child.

Participants only need to bring themselves.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_8c7bc5c7207746189d297e182618964f~mv2.png)

Meet your host

Lysanne Sizoo is a psychosynthesis psychotherapist and the founder of the Star Psychology method. For over twenty-five years, she has guided individuals through a holistic approach that connects psychology, astrology, and human design.

• How to understand and work with inner conflicts

In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll get a simple, eye-opening introduction to your inner world using your birth chart — no experience needed. summary: Join us for a two-hour deep dive into the restorative magic of winter. This intimate event invites you to explore what you've achieved so far this year and how to slow down, ready for the quiet and reflection that winter encourages.
description:
Join Compassionate Inquiry practitioner and health coach Melanie

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e8301f_f132be62689247008cab4255643677ae~mv2.jpg)

Bertaud for an exploration into winter's invitation to slow down, reflect,

and rest, and how to cultivate winter's energy as we come to the end of

the year.

This event includes a 30-minute guided meditation to connect with deep

peace and your body's wisdom. This will be followed by a facilitated

sharing circle where you will be invited to discuss the topic of winter and

what it means to you, and to connect with the wisdom of the group.

There will also be time for self-reflection and journalling.

With no more than 8 participants, this event offers a calm and safe

space for you to get in touch with your inner world and gain insights to

harness winter's slower, reflective energy.

What to expect:

Duration: 2.5 hours

Group size: 8 participants maximum

Includes: tea, plant-based snacks, blankets

How to prepare: wear comfortable clothing; bring your yoga mat; bring a

journal and pen if you wish

Who is this event for?

This event is open to adults looking to create peace and quiet in their

inner world and cultivate more self-kindness, while connecting with

others.

You will be invited to share your experience of winter, your achievements

and challenges this year, and how you're welcoming this new season.

However, there is no pressure to share if you do not feel like it.

No meditation experience is required.

Price:

Low-income: €15

Normal: €25

Support: €40 – purchasing a supporter ticket helps finance a ticket for

someone who can't afford it

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_bdd2290f47d6454382b7cfe724c95c8a~mv2.jpg)

Meet Your Host

Melanie Bertaud is a Compassionate Inquiry practitioner and health coach based in Delft. She blends trauma-informed somatic work with a holistic approach to support people in reconnecting with authenticity, wellbeing, and inner balance.

title: Free Learning Series: Natural Remedies for the Home
location: The Hague Natural Health Centre, Badhuisstraat 224, 2584 HN Den Haag, Netherlands
registration_text: Get Tickets
summary: Ready to build your family’s natural medicine chest? Join our free learning series at The Hague Natural Health Centre to master tissue salts, flower essences & homeopathic first aid with Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner, Sandra Quist.
description:
Empower Your Family’s Health with Natural Remedies

Take control of your family's wellness with safe, gentle, and easy-to-use natural remedies. Join us for a relaxed, educational series designed to equip parents and individuals with practical tools to support the body and mind naturally.

Your host is Sandra Quist, a Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner with over 12 years of teaching experience including 7 years of clinical experience. This informal workshop series aims to provide people with a basic understanding of natural remedies so that they do not feel so mysterious. We aim to have fun so bring your questions no matter how silly or serious they might be!

### What You Will Learn

The series is divided into 3 modules, each focusing on a different way of approaching health via physical symptoms, emotional symptoms and most often both at the same time. Although each module can stand alone, it is recommended that you join at least two of the same modules in order to give you a strong understanding of feeling confident to begin using them on your own. It is the first time we host this learning series at the Natural Health Centre so the timing and content may vary slightly depending on the audience and pace of questions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_a5d96a9632bb44ff8481f8f18b4c1717~mv2.png)

#### Oct 19 & Nov 16:

#### Introduction to Schuessler Tissue Salts 
(Physical Body Support)

Learn how these 12 essential mineral salts support physical functions and help manage everyday ailments. Tissue Salts are bascially energetic versions of electrolytes. This workshop covers:

- What are tissue salts and why they are vital to cellular health.
- The 12 core tissue salts and common combination remedies,
- Practical tools for common conditions: colds, minor asthma support, bedwetting, chickenpox, measles, colic, cramps, fevers, hemorrhoids, hair loss, hay fever, and brain fog.

#### Dec 7 & Jan 11:

#### Flower Essences (Emotional Balance)

Discover gentle flower remedies designed to support emotional well-being and stress management.

- Fundamentals of flower essences and how they are prepared.
- Practical applications of traditional Bach Flower Essences.
- Introduction to pre-combined flower essences for quick and easy daily use.

#### Feb 8:

#### Homeopathic First Aid (Acute Care)

Introduction to the basics of homeopathy and managing everyday injuries, acute illnesses, and sudden stresses.

- Core principles and philosophy behind homeopathic remedies.
- How to select and administer remedies for colds, emotional distress, minor injuries, sunburn, food poisoning, grief, and more.
- There's so much you can do to support your family with natural remedies, start to learn about it!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_679501fba6b24163a9402644af9c3014~mv2.png)

### Prerequisites & Attendance

- Registration Required: This is a free event, however due to limited capacity, you must register for each event. We also ask that you kindly cancel your attendance if you are unable to attend in order to allow someone else to take your place.
- Who it’s for: Open to everyone, especially mothers, fathers, and caregivers looking to educate themselves on natural health. No prior experience is required, just an open and curious mind.
- Format: You are welcome to attend individual sessions as your schedule allows. However, to get the most value and to participate in Q&A sessions, we strongly recommend attending both months of a specific topic (e.g., both Tissue Salt modules).
The intention is to have fun, ask questions, let your curiosty lead you to learn something new that can actually support you and your family in a natural, sustainable and non-invasive way.

summary: Do you have a talk, workshop or event that you would like to facilitate, suggest or share with our community? description:
This is NOT an event.

This is an announcement to speakers, practitioners or facilitators in our community that would like to come and share their skills. If you have an idea that would benefit the community, please get in touch. Or to members of our local and wider community that would like to suggest a speaker or  topics that are affecting you, we welcome your input.

The more knowledge we share, the healthier and happier we can be.
